jobs.title: Senior Project Manager, Green Building Certifications
jobs.description:
**About Earth Advantage**

Earth Advantage is a non\-profit organization helping to advance a more informed and humane housing market. We work to ensure the US housing market *recognizes* the elements of homes that create climate risk and *values* the characteristics of homes that provide climate solutions. Our teams partner with entities across the country to develop tangible, systemic solutions for climate\-friendly housing.

Earth Advantage is an equal\-opportunity employer that values diversity at all levels. We are committed to providing an inclusive, non\-discriminatory, and welcoming environment for all staff members, partners, subcontractors, and vendors. We are actively engaged in an ongoing process to identify and address inequities in our programming, organizational culture, community, and industry. We enthusiastically encourage individuals from Black, Indigenous, Latinx, Asian, and LGBTQ\+ backgrounds to apply.

We're proud of the culture we're building at Earth Advantage, and we believe in walking the talk when it comes to sustainability. We're currently ranked in the top 10 of both Oregon Business Magazine's 100 Greenest Companies and 100 Best Nonprofits to Work For in Oregon. If you’re interested in joining an organization with incredible benefits and staffed with intelligent and dedicated people, this is the place for you. Learn more on our website.

**Who we’re looking for**

You are an experienced project manager who is comfortable supporting complex new multifamily development projects. You possess sound technical judgment, excellent communication skills, and the ability to guide multidisciplinary teams toward successful project outcomes. You are motivated to support the regional housing industry, and are comfortable working with affordable housing organizations, developers, architects, engineers, contractors, consultants, public agencies, and internal technical specialists.

You have a strong foundation in multifamily construction and building science, an ability to learn technical standards, and the judgment to know when to independently resolve an issue and when to engage additional technical expertise. You do not need to be an expert in each green building certification program on day one. However, you will be able to translate complex certification and technical requirements into clear priorities, decisions, and next steps for project teams.

This position is primarily a project management role focused on the successful delivery of multifamily green building certification projects, including technical review, certification coordination, client support, and internal process management. You will work closely with Earth Advantage's field verification and energy modeling staff to deliver successful project outcomes. While this position is not primarily responsible for field verification or energy modeling, opportunities to contribute technical expertise may arise based on organizational needs and individual experience.

You may have opportunities to represent Earth Advantage as a technical subject matter expert in client education events, workforce trainings, conference presentations, workshops, research initiatives, and other industry engagement activities throughout the Pacific Northwest.

**What you’ll be doing**

***Project Management:*** 

Serve as the primary project manager and client contact for assigned multifamily certification projects from design through final certification.

* Manage a portfolio of multifamily projects pursuing Earth Advantage Multifamily, LEED for Homes, and/or other recognized green building and energy certifications.
* Develop and manage project schedules, certification milestones, deliverables, dependencies, and deadlines. Ensure all project communications, documentation, and deliverables are complete, accurate, clear and professionally presented.
* Coordinate certification services associated with affordable housing funding, incentive, financing, tax credit, or verifier requirements when included within the project scope.
* Maintain accurate project information within Earth Advantage's customer relationship management, project management, and file management systems.

***Technical Review \& Certification:*** 

Apply building science knowledge and technical judgment to guide projects through certification requirements.

* Review construction drawings, specifications, product data, cut sheets, approved submittals, and other project documentation for certification compliance.
* Understand the interaction between certification requirements, project design decisions, construction practices, and building performance.
* Coordinate with Earth Advantage field verification staff to ensure required inspections, testing, checklists, and supporting documentation are completed at appropriate project milestones.
* Collaborate with energy modeling staff to coordinate project information, assumptions, design changes, documentation, and modeling deliverables.

***Client Support \& Industry Engagement:*** 

Provide responsive, knowledgeable, and solutions\-oriented support throughout the certification process and serving as a trusted point of contact for clients and project teams.

* Support affordable housing organizations and project teams in navigating certification requirements associated with high\-performance and sustainable housing goals.
* Build productive, long\-term relationships with developers, affordable housing organizations, architects, engineers, contractors, and other project partners.
* Explain complex technical and certification requirements in ways that are understandable and actionable for different audiences.
* Participate in relevant client meetings, conferences, industry events, and occasional project site visits.

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
Position Description:

Valiant Solutions is seeking a **Business Analyst** to support our agile software development practice supporting an environmentally focused Federal Government client.  

The agency's programs aim to promote environmental sustainability and protect the natural resources of our planet. As part of this contract, we will be supporting the agency's efforts to develop and maintain information systems that facilitate the tracking and reporting of environmental data. Our team will work closely with the agency to ensure that the information systems are secure, compliant with accessibility standards, and support the agency's business processes.  

As a **Business Analyst**, the role will involve working closely with the project team to gather and analyze business requirements, translate them into functional specifications, and ensure that they align with the project goals and objectives. The business analyst will be responsible for identifying potential areas of improvement in business processes, and work with stakeholders to identify solutions and improvements. The Business Analyst will also collaborate with the development team to ensure that the system's user interface and user experience meet the needs of stakeholders. They will assist in designing intuitive and user\-friendly interfaces and participate in user acceptance testing to verify that the system meets the functional and non\-functional requirements. The business analyst will assist in the development and implementation of new information systems, including conducting user acceptance testing and coordinating with developers to ensure that business requirements are met. The business analyst will also support the project manager in tracking and managing project timelines and deliverables, and will communicate progress and issues to stakeholders on a regular basis.  

Named one of the**Best Places to Work** **in the Washington DC area for 12 consecutive years**, Valiant is proud of our employee\-centric culture and commitment to excellence. If you are interested in learning more about Valiant and this opportunity, we invite you to apply now! ***This position allows for 100% remote work. * Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, or a related field is preferred, but not required

* Business process modeling and mapping tools such as Visio, Lucidchart, and BPMN notation.
* Data modeling and analysis techniques such as entity\-relationship diagrams and data flow diagrams.
* Agile development methodologies such as Scrum or Kanban.
* Project management tools such as Microsoft Project, Trello, or Asana.
* Collaboration tools such as Microsoft Teams, Slack, or JIRA.
* Business intelligence and reporting tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or Cognos.
* Basic technical knowledge and understanding of software development and database technologies.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills for effective communication with stakeholders, management, and development teams.

jobs.title: Site Program Manager
jobs.description:
**About High Performance Academy (HPA)**  

  

High Performance Academy (HPA) is on a mission to empower individuals to reach their potential through sports enrichment, and positive development experiences. We partner with schools and districts across California to provide dynamic, inclusive, and high\-quality after\-school and enrichment programs, camps and leagues that combine sports, social\-emotional learning, and mentorship. Our goal is to serve 100,000 youth by 2030 through experiences that build confidence, teamwork, and lifelong skills, on and off the field.  

  

**ABOUT THE ROLE**
  

The Site Program Manager is a hands\-on operational leader responsible for ensuring High Performance Academy's Programs, Camps, and Leagues are delivered with consistency, quality, and operational excellence. Reporting to the Area Manager, this role oversees daily program operations, staff leadership, scheduling, training, and program execution while serving as the primary point of support for coaches, partners, and program sites. The Site Program Manager plays a critical role in maintaining HPA's program standards, developing team members, managing logistics and performance, and fostering strong relationships with school and community partners. This position is ideal for a proactive leader who thrives in a fast\-paced environment, enjoys developing people, solving operational challenges, and creating exceptional experiences for youth, staff, and partners. This role is a remote opportunity, with travel to visit program sites as required.  

  

  

**HOW YOU'LL CONTRIBUTE*** **Lead \& Develop Teams**: Recruit, onboard, coach, evaluate, and support program staff while fostering accountability, professional growth, and a positive team culture.
* **Oversee Daily Operations**: Manage staffing, scheduling, attendance, timesheets, program logistics, and site operations to ensure seamless program delivery.
* **Deliver High\-Quality Programs**: Ensure Programs, Camps, and Leagues consistently meet HPA's standards for safety, quality, engagement, and youth development.
* **Drive Operational Excellence**: Monitor program performance, track KPIs, manage budgets, analyze operational data, and implement continuous improvements.
* **Build Strong Partnerships**: Serve as the primary liaison for school partners, families, and community stakeholders while supporting recruitment, onboarding, and employee engagement initiatives.
* **Improve Systems \& Processes**: Contribute to documenting and refining operational procedures, best practices, and scalable systems that strengthen program consistency across regions.
* **Champion HPA Culture**: Lead with integrity, accountability, and compassion while promoting HPA's core values, supporting employee engagement, and creating an exceptional experience for both staff and students.

We’re looking for someone who lives our HPA Core Values. At HPA, our values start with “I” and end in “us”
* **Integrity** – You do what’s right, even when no one’s watching.
* **Caring** – You lead with empathy and put others first.
* **Driven** – You’re committed to growth, on and off the field.
* **Resourceful** – You’re a creative problem solver, always finding ways to make things work.
* **Team Player** – You believe we’re better together and always show up for your team.

* 3\+ years of experience in program coordination or a related field
* Strong organizational and leadership skills
* Effective communication and interpersonal abilities
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively, managing multiple tasks, projects, and people simultaneously
* Demonstrated ability in problem solving, program development, and operational excellence
* Proficient in Microsoft Office and project management software
* Must be available occasionally on Saturdays
* Knowledge of program evaluation and budget management
* Experience working in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment, ideally with exposure to educational, community, or youth programs
* Familiarity with sports programs, educational system and community outreach
* Passion for working with youth and making a positive impact in the community
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, project management software (Asana and Ninety), and HRIS/scheduling tools (Paycor, Deputy, or equivalent)
* Experience in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment – ideally in youth development, education, community programs, or sports/enrichment
* Passion for youth development and a deep commitment to HPA's mission to serve 100,000 youth by 2030

**Why You’ll Love Working Here**
* Salary: 76,000\-81,000 annually, based on experience.
* Medical/Virtual Care, Dental and Vision Insurance Plans for you and your dependents
* Paid Time Off\-We understand the importance of time to rest and recharge.
* Paid Holidays/Paid Sick Leave
* Financial Wellness \- 401(k)/Retirement and Financial Coaching with our EAP

jobs.title: Senior Project & Program Manager
jobs.description:
**We're transforming the grocery industry**



At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.



Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.


**Instacart is a Flex First team**

There’s no one\-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in\-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

**Overview**
------------



Instacart's Customer Experience \& Operations organization is at the heart of how we support the millions of customers, shoppers, and partners who rely on our platform every day. Within that organization, the CX Technology Programs team is responsible for driving the development and deployment of technology solutions that meaningfully improve the support experience at scale.

  



We are looking for a CX Technology Program Manager to join a small, high\-impact team working at the intersection of automation, operations, and product execution. This role sits within a team of three — two individual contributors and a people manager — and will play a critical role in bringing structure, coordination, and momentum to an ambitious chatbot automation program. With 14 automations currently in active development across Shopper and Customer support programs and significant monthly cost savings on the line, this is a role where your work will have immediate, measurable business impact. If you thrive in fast\-moving environments, are energized by complexity, and know how to drive programs forward without waiting for perfect conditions, this role is for you.

  


**About the Job**
-----------------


* Own end\-to\-end planning and coordination for a portfolio of chatbot automation initiatives spanning both Shopper and Customer support programs, ensuring timelines, dependencies, and stakeholders are aligned across concurrent workstreams.
* Drive program execution in an environment where priorities shift and the roadmap evolves — you'll be the connective tissue between technical teams, operations, and leadership, keeping work moving and risks visible.
* Build and maintain the operational infrastructure for the CX Technology Programs team, including program tracking, status reporting, and cross\-functional communication rhythms that give stakeholders confidence in the work underway.
* Partner closely with product, engineering, and CX operations teams to scope, sequence, and launch automation solutions, translating business goals into clear plans with defined milestones and accountability.
* Identify gaps, surface blockers early, and propose solutions — this team is currently under\-resourced on the planning and coordination side, and you will be stepping in to immediately add structure and move critical work forward.

  


**About You**
-------------



Minimum Qualifications


* 5\+ years of experience in program management, technical program management, or operations program management, ideally within a technology, e\-commerce, or customer experience organization.
* Demonstrated experience managing multiple concurrent programs with cross\-functional stakeholders, including the ability to build and maintain program plans, track dependencies, and communicate status clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Experience working on or alongside automation, AI, or chatbot technology programs, with a working understanding of how these solutions are scoped, built, and deployed in an operational context.
* Proficiency with project and program management tools (e.g., Jira, Asana, Monday.com, or similar) and comfort using data to track progress and communicate impact.
* Proven ability to operate independently and create structure in ambiguous environments, including stepping into under\-resourced programs and quickly establishing clarity and momentum.

  



Preferred Qualifications


* Experience working within a customer support or CX technology environment, with familiarity with support operations metrics, tooling ecosystems (e.g., Salesforce, Zendesk, or similar), or automation\-driven cost reduction programs.
* Background working in a high\-growth or fast\-paced technology company where priorities evolve quickly and cross\-functional coordination spans multiple teams simultaneously.
* Experience contributing to or managing programs with measurable financial impact, such as cost savings targets, efficiency initiatives, or automation ROI tracking.
* Comfort engaging with technical concepts and product development processes, with the ability to have informed conversations with engineering and product partners without needing deep technical expertise yourself.

  



\#LI\-Remote


Instacart provides highly market\-competitive compensation and benefits in each location where our employees work. This role is remote and the base pay range for a successful candidate is dependent on their permanent work location. Please review our Flex First remote work policy here.



Offers may vary based on many factors, such as candidate experience and skills required for the role. Additionally, this role is eligible for a new hire equity grant as well as annual refresh grants. Please read more about our benefits offerings here.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Strategy & Operations (Remote)
jobs.description:
We are seeking a **Program Manager, Strategy \& Operations** to join the Office of the President. In this role, you will serve as the quarterback for our Annual Operating Plan (AOP) and Objectives and Key Results (OKRs), driving the disciplined execution and operational excellence required to meet Aledade’s strategic priorities.
  

As a strategic operator and internal consultant, you will partner with leaders across the organization to turn high\-level vision into actionable outcomes. You will be instrumental in bridging the gap between strategy and execution—fostering cross\-functional collaboration, proactively addressing roadblocks, and ensuring our teams remain aligned with our most ambitious goals.
  

This is a unique opportunity to gain direct exposure to senior leadership while developing your operational toolkit. By ensuring our business objectives are translated into successful results, you will contribute directly to Aledade’s mission of empowering independent primary care.

We are flexible with respect to geographic location, and the ideal candidate will be comfortable working remotely/work from home within the US or be based from Bethesda, MD office.

**Primary Duties:**
-------------------



### **Performance Management:**

* **Drive Accountability:** Own the end\-to\-end performance management of AOP Objectives and Key Results, ensuring owners are empowered and accountable for delivering on their targets.
* **Maintain Operational Tempo:** Act as the heartbeat of the AOP, ensuring consistent progress through proactive follow\-ups, closing feedback loops, and keeping cross\-functional workstreams on schedule.
* **Surface \& Mitigate Risk:** Early\-identify systemic risks or operational blockers to OKR success; partner with teams to develop mitigation strategies and escalate critical issues to leadership to ensure a path forward.

### **Strategic \& Annual Planning:**

* **Lead Planning Cycles:** Facilitate the departmental annual planning process and mid\-year (2H) adjustments, ensuring departmental goals remain ambitious yet realistic.
* **Continue to Build the Playbook:** Continuously refine and document the AOP Playbook at Aledade, codifying best practices to make each planning cycle more efficient and predictable than the last.
* **QBR Preparation:** Partner with department Ops Leads to prepare high\-quality materials and narratives for Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), ensuring a data\-driven story of progress and challenges.

### **Cross\-Functional Orchestration \& Alignment:**

* **Stakeholder Management:** Build deep, trust\-based relationships across the organization to facilitate honest discussions regarding progress, resource gaps, and cross\-departmental dependencies.
* **Early Alignment Integration:** Act as the "glue" between departments, ensuring that initiatives have early and consistent alignment with Analytics, Field, and Product stakeholders.
* **Cross\-Functional Bridge:** Serve as the central point of contact to ensure that changes in one department’s roadmap are communicated and reconciled with the broader AOP.

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 5\+ years progressive experience in operations, strategy, program management or consulting
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience

### **Preferred knowledge, skills, and/or abilities:**

* Master’s degree preferred
* Proven ability to build strong relationships, influence without authority, and effectively collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including senior leaders.
* Demonstrated experience in managing projects, tracking performance, and driving execution in a complex environment.  

Ability to think critically, identify issues, and develop actionable strategic solutions.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate complex information to diverse audiences and influence stakeholders.
* Self\-motivated, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability for outcomes.

### **Physical Requirements:**


* Sitting for prolonged periods of time. Extensive use of computers and keyboard. Occasional walking and lifting may be required.
**Who We Are:**
Aledade PBC, a public benefit corporation, exists to empower the most transformational part of our health care landscape \- independent primary care. We were founded in 2014, and since then, we've become the largest network of independent primary care in the country \- helping practices, health centers and clinics deliver better care to their patients and thrive in value\-based care. Additionally, by creating value\-based contracts across a wide variety of health plans, we aim to flip the script on the traditional fee\-for\-service model. Our work strengthens continuity of care, aligns incentives and ensures primary care physicians are paid for what they do best \- keeping patients healthy. If you want to help create a health care system that is good for patients, good for practices and good for society \- and if you're eager to join a collaborative, inclusive and remote\-first culture \- you've come to the right place.

**What Does This Mean for You?**
At Aledade PBC, you will be part of a creative culture that is driven by a passion for tackling complex issues with respect, open\-mindedness and a desire to learn. You will collaborate with team members who bring a wide range of experiences, interests, backgrounds, beliefs and achievements to their work \- and who are all united by a shared passion for public health and a commitment to the Aledade mission.

In addition to time off to support work\-life balance and enjoyment, we offer the following comprehensive benefits package designed for the overall well\-being of our team members:

Flexible work schedules and the ability to work remotely are available for many roles
Health, dental and vision insurance paid up to 80% for employees, dependents and domestic partners
Robust time\-off plan (21 days of PTO in your first year)
Two paid volunteer days and

**Job Title:** Senior Business Analyst \- Utilities \| FSM / ERP Implementations (Multiple positions available)  

**Company:** Celerity Consulting Group  

**Location**: Remote (work from home eligible) with the ability to travel for client meetings and workshops  

**Salary:** $100,000 \- $120,000 annually DOE  

  

**Company Overview:** Celerity is a consulting firm specializing in the utilities and energy sectors. We empower organizations by converting complex data into actionable intelligence to mitigate risk, optimize assets, and maximize project outcomes. Our background and expertise enable us to drive and deliver transformation and operational excellence for our clients. Our background and expertise also enable us to implement enterprise systems \& solutions, driving digital transformation and operational excellence for our clients.  

  

**Position Overview:** We are seeking a Senior Business Analyst with over 8 years of experience in implementing projects for enterprise systems (ERPs, CRMs, FSM, etc.) and a strong background in the utilities/energy/telecom industries. The ideal candidate will play a pivotal role in analyzing client business processes, identifying requirements, and implementing solutions to enhance operational efficiency.  

  

**Key Responsibilities:**  

**Requirements Gathering and Analysis:*** Engage with clients to understand and document their business processes, needs, and objectives related to field service operations.
* Analyze and translate business requirements into functional specifications for enterprise solutions.
* Conduct gap analyses to identify areas where current systems fall short of client needs.

**Solution Design and Implementation:*** Collaborate with technical teams to design solutions that align with client requirements and industry best practices.
* Assist in configuring and customizing tools to meet specific client needs.
* Develop and execute test plans to ensure solutions meet specified requirements and quality standards.

**Stakeholder Communication and Management:*** Serve as a liaison between clients, project managers, and technical teams to ensure clear communication and alignment throughout the project lifecycle.
* Facilitate workshops and meetings to gather requirements, present solutions, and obtain stakeholder buy\-in.
* Prepare and deliver presentations and reports to clients and internal stakeholders.

**Process Improvement and Optimization:*** Identify opportunities to enhance client business processes through the effective use of FSM solutions.
* Recommend best practices and innovative solutions to improve field service operations and efficiency.
* Monitor solution performance and suggest enhancements based on data analysis and client feedback.

**Testing*** Hands on experience writing detailed user stories, test cases and executing tests. Should have an eye for details and be familiar with arduous test cases.
* Experience logging, tracking, prioritizing and validating defects.
* Experience guiding new users through individual and collaborative UAT sessions.
* Should be familiar with navigating difficult conversations with users when bugs are uncovered or business needs are deprioritized for the scope of the project.

**Training and Support:*** Develop training materials and conduct training sessions for clients to ensure successful adoption of enterprise solutions.
* Provide ongoing support to clients’ post\-implementation to address issues and optimize solution usage

**Educational Qualifications:*** Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field required.
* Advanced degree (MBA or Master’s) is preferred.

**Required Skills and Experience:*** Minimum of 7 years of experience as a Business Analyst, with a focus on Enterprise Field Service Management and mobile workforce solutions.
* Demonstrated experience in requirements gathering, process analysis, and solution implementation.
* Hands\-on experience with SQL to access, retrieve, manipulate, and analyze data.
* Hands\-on experience with Jira, Confluence, MS SharePoint, Process design tools (Vizio, Signavio, etc.) and similar PMO tools.
* Strong understanding of utility operations, asset management, and field service management (REQUIRED)
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to think critically and propose effective solutions.
* Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage effectively with clients and stakeholders at all levels.
* Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
* Familiarity with business integration requirements across technology stack (ERP, CRM, CIS, BI, Datawarehouse, etc.)
* Ability to travel to client sites (domestic and(or) international) as required and defined per project requirements.

**Preferred Skills:*** Consulting background with experience in client\-facing roles and managing stakeholder relationships.
* Proficiency in using FSM software platforms a plus.
* Familiarity with GIS integration and mobile workforce management solutions.
* Knowledge of emerging technologies such as IoT, AI, and Machine Learning as they apply to Field Service Management.
* Professional certifications related to Business Analysis (e.g., CBAP) or Project Management (e.g., PMP).

**Customer Delivery Project Manager** **About the Role**

The Customer Delivery Project Manager leads the successful onboarding and launch of Pearson’s Institutional Sales solutions for our higher education customers. From contract signature through go\-live, you will serve as the customer’s primary delivery partner, coordinating the people, activities, and decisions needed for a successful implementation.


This is a customer\-facing role combining relationship management, solution\-oriented problem\-solving, and structured project delivery. You will take time to understand each customer’s goals and operating environment, guide them through key decisions, and keep internal and customer stakeholders aligned.


You do not need to be a technical expert or perform system configuration yourself. You will partner with technical and product specialists, helping translate complex information into clear actions for the customer.


**Key Responsibilities** **Lead the Customer Experience**

* Serve as the primary delivery contact throughout the implementation
* Build trusted relationships with customer stakeholders and create confidence in the delivery process
* Lead customer kickoff meetings and establish shared goals, responsibilities, timelines, and ways of working
* Understand each institution’s priorities, processes, stakeholders, and academic deadlines
* Guide customers through implementation decisions and manage expectations throughout the journey

**Plan and Coordinate Delivery**

* Develop and manage implementation plans covering milestones, responsibilities, dependencies, and timelines and risks
* Coordinate activities across customers and internal teams, including Sales, Product, Technical Implementation, and Support
* Bring the right specialists into customer conversations at the appropriate time
* Maintain clear progress reporting and ensure stakeholders understand priorities and next steps
* Manage multiple implementations while providing a responsive and high\-quality customer experience

**Prepare Customers for Launch**

* Lead go\-live readiness reviews and confirm that customer and Pearson requirements have been completed
* Ensure stakeholders understand the launch plan, support arrangements, and outstanding actions
* Coordinate a smooth transition to ongoing account management, customer success and technical support teams
* Document implementation outcomes, outstanding items, and lessons learned

**What We Are Looking For**

* Experience leading customer onboarding, implementation, service delivery, or other customer\-facing projects
* Strong customer relationship and stakeholder management skills
* A solution\-oriented mindset and the ability to turn challenges into practical actions
* Strong planning, organization, and prioritization skills
* Clear and confident communication across customer, business, and technical audiences
* Ability to coordinate cross\-functional teams and drive accountability without direct authority
* Confidence managing changing requirements, competing priorities, and difficult conversations
* Comfort working with digital products or technology\-enabled services without being a technical specialist
* Experience in higher education, education technology, publishing, or another complex customer environment would be an advantage

This is not a software development, Scrum Master, Product Owner, or deeply technical project management role. The focus is on customer partnership, implementation planning, stakeholder coordination, practical problem\-solving, and successful delivery.

jobs.description:

**Department**
--------------


Marketing


  
SEON is the command center for fraud prevention and AML compliance, helping thousands of companies worldwide stop fraud, reduce risk and protect revenue. Powered by 900\+ real\-time, first\-party data signals, SEON enriches customer profiles, flags suspicious behavior and streamlines compliance workflows \- all from one place. SEON provides richer data, more flexible and transparent analysis, and faster time to value than any other provider on the market. We’ve helped companies reduce fraud by 95% and achieve 32x ROI, and we’re growing fast, thanks to our partnerships with some of the world’s most ambitious digital brands like Revolut, Wise, and Bilt.


We’re hiring a Lead Competitive Intelligence Manager to own our competitive program end\-to\-end: meaning you’ll define the strategy, gather and synthesize intel, activate it across GTM and product teams, support sales in the field, and continuously measure and evolve the program—helping us uncover new business opportunities, drive revenue, and sharpen our position in the fraud prevention and AML compliance space.


We’re looking for someone who’s naturally curious and resourceful, with a knack for uncovering hard\-to\-find insights, cutting through the noise of a crowded market, and turning scattered anecdotes into meaningful trends. You’re someone who loves to understand how things work – especially when it comes to product differentiation – and you take pride in translating that understanding into clear, actionable guidance. If you thrive on turning complexity into clarity and enjoy working cross\-functionally to drive meaningful impact, this role is for you.

### **What you’ll do**

* Design and execute a comprehensive CI strategy: monitor competitive moves, emerging threats, pricing changes, new product launches, partnerships, and market shifts in real time.
* Conduct primary (e.g. field interviews, deal\-call participation) and secondary (e.g. public filings, analyst reports, blogs, technical documentation, competitor websites) research to build a robust competitive database.
* Develop and maintain competitive enablement such as battlecards, feature‑comparison matrices, win/loss analysis summaries, objection\-handling plays, and other resources that equip sales and customer\-facing teams.
* Provide strategic support throughout the sales cycle—attending key prospect or customer calls to inject competitive perspective and help navigate head\-to\-head situations.
* Feed lessons from the field back to marketing and sales enablement to inform messaging, campaigns, and positioning adjustments—also spearheading targeted campaigns when competitor moves emerge.
* Own CI knowledge management: centralize and curate competitive intel from across the business and package insights for different internal audiences, from granular product detail to sales\-ready talking points.
* Collaborate with product teams to translate competitive and market insight into roadmap guidance and differentiation strategy.
* Evaluate competitor product architectures, translating technical findings into business\-impact assessments.
* Continuously optimize how we use competitive intelligence tools and workflows, leveraging the latest AI capabilities to increase efficiency and accuracy.

### **What experience you bring**

* 5\+ years of competitive intelligence/strategy in enterprise B2B SaaS
* Domain expertise in fraud prevention, AML/KYC compliance, cybersecurity, or related field.
* Experience creating and managing a centralized CI knowledge base that scales across functions.
* Hands\-on experience creating battlecards, competitive playbooks, win/loss analyses, and supporting sales in live calls.
* Strong technical aptitude enabling credible engagement with engineering teams, data scientists, and technical prospects during competitive evaluations.
* Proven ability to turn raw data, competitor signals, and field intel into actionable sales plays, positioning shifts, and product guidance.
* Strong analytical skills: comfortable gathering data from varied sources, synthesizing it into crisp, compelling insights.
* Proven ability to turn competitive insights into actionable recommendations for product and GTM teams, with a focus on measurable impact through sales effectiveness and win/loss outcomes.
* Excellent communicator, both verbally and in writing—able to present complex competitive landscapes effectively to diverse internal and external audiences.
* Self\-starter: highly collaborative across functions (sales, marketing, product, CS), with an ability to manage CI initiatives end\-to\-end.
* Familiarity with CI tools (e.g. Klue, Crayon) and market intelligence platforms.

jobs.title: Senior Talent Intelligence Analyst
jobs.description:
**About the team**
------------------

Zillow’s Talent Intelligence team provides objective external market research and intelligence to inform talent, workforce, and organizational decisions. We serve as internal consultants to executives and leaders, bringing a vital “outside\-in” perspective to complex business questions. Our engagements may include talent and skills market analysis, competitive and organizational intelligence, leadership research, location strategy, and emerging workforce trends. By translating external data into clear implications and recommendations, we help Zillow’s leadership make more informed decisions in a distributed, CloudHQ environment.
**About the role**
------------------

As a Senior Talent Intelligence Analyst, you are a strategic research partner to Zillow’s leadership, owning the team’s most complex and highest\-visibility engagements. You sit at the intersection of external market intelligence and business strategy, helping leaders frame ambiguous questions, understand relevant market dynamics, and evaluate potential paths forward. You will design and lead a range of research engagements across evolving talent, workforce, and organizational priorities, bringing sound judgment, analytical rigor, and clear recommendations with minimal oversight


**You will get to:**

* Lead complex, ambiguous Talent Intelligence engagements from initial scoping through executive delivery, determining the appropriate research approach, data sources, analysis, and outputs for each business question.
* Build external market intelligence across a range of evolving topics, which may include talent and skills markets, competitive and organizational insights, leadership profiles, location strategy, and broader workforce trends.
* Use advanced intelligence tools and diverse external sources to identify market patterns, benchmarks, risks, and opportunities relevant to Zillow’s talent and organizational priorities.
* Conduct competitive and organizational research to help leaders understand how other companies build, structure, scale, and evolve their teams and capabilities.
* Translate complex quantitative and qualitative research into clear implications, options, and recommendations that support informed decision\-making.
* Synthesize findings into executive\-ready narratives, briefings, and visualizations, presenting directly to VPs and senior stakeholders.
* Act as a strategic thought partner to executives, business leaders, and Talent Acquisition, advising on how external intelligence can inform both near\- and long\-term priorities.
* Help evolve the Talent Intelligence function by identifying new use cases, methodologies, data sources, tools, and offerings while mentoring and raising the bar for the broader team.

The base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.
In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.
**Who you are**
---------------

* You have a “detective” mindset and know how to combine intelligence tools, public information, and sound research judgment to answer ambiguous, high\-stakes business and talent questions.
* You can distill complex research into high\-level themes and narratives that resonate with C\-suite and executive audiences.
* You have a high bar for data integrity and are comfortable navigating large, diverse datasets to find clear, actionable insights.
* You build trust by providing objective, high\-quality research that helps leaders solve complex organizational problems.
* You are an experienced, credible partner to senior stakeholders, able to manage up and negotiate scope without formal authority.
* You enjoy mentoring and developing the skills of less experienced analysts.

**Qualifications:**

* 8\+ years of experience in talent intelligence, market research, management consulting, or a high\-level recruitment strategy role, including experience independently owning complex, ambiguous projects end\-to\-end.
* Use generative AI, advanced intelligence platforms, and diverse external sources to identify market patterns, benchmarks, risks, and opportunities

jobs.description:
The Health Economics Data Analyst is responsible for supporting financial and operational integrity through the accurate extraction, validation, analysis, and reconciliation of healthcare and financial data. This role focuses on Plan‑to‑Plan (P2P) activity, claims and encounter data, invoicing, and inter‑entity financial transactions to ensure alignment with contractual requirements and payment structures.


The Health Economics Data Analyst works cross‑functionally with Finance, Revenue Management, and Member Services to deliver reliable data insights that support business operations, financial reporting, and decision‑making. The position requires strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage complex data from multiple systems in a regulated healthcare environment.


1\. Perform data extraction and validation from multiple sources.  



  

Performance Standards:  

* Accurately extracts required data from multiple sources within established timelines.
* Validates data for completeness, accuracy, and consistency, promptly identifying and correcting discrepancies.
* Maintains proper documentation of data sources, queries, and validation steps to ensure data integrity and audit readiness.

2\. Analyze Plan\-to\-Plan (P2P) data, including inter\-plan transactions, cost sharing, and financial reconciliation between entities.

  

Performance Standards:  

* Analyzes data accurately and in accordance with organizational and regulatory requirements.
* Identifies variances, trends, or discrepancies in inter plan transactions and cost sharing arrangements.
* Communicates findings clearly and supports reconciliation efforts to ensure timely and accurate financial settlement between entities.
  

3\. Review and reconcile invoices and claims\-related financial data, ensuring alignment with contracts and payment structures.

  

Performance Standards:  

* Reviews invoices and claims related financial data for accuracy, completeness, and contractual compliance.
* Reconciles discrepancies efficiently, collaborating with internal and external stakeholders as needed.
* Ensure reconciliations are completed within required timeframes and supports accurate financial reporting.
  

4\. Extract, transform, and analyze data from multiple sources (claims systems, data warehouses, financial systems).  

Performance Standards:  

* Effectively extracts and transforms data from claims systems, data warehouses, and financial systems to support analysis and reporting needs.
* Apply appropriate data transformation techniques to ensure usability and consistency.
* Produces reliable analyses that support operational, financial, and regulatory decision making.
  

5\. Partner with Finance, Revenue Management and Member Services teams to support business and operational needs.


Performance Standards:

* Collaborates proactively with Finance, Revenue Management, and Member Services to understand data and reporting requirements.
* Provides timely, accurate, and relevant data insights to support business operations and decision making.
* Responds professionally to requests and maintains effective working relationships across departments.
* Bachelor’s degree in Economics, Finance, Data Analytics or Computer Science.
* 2\+ years of experience in data analysis, preferably in a managed care or payer environment
* Experience with SQL and advanced Excel
* Experience working with encounter/claims data
* Experience with financial data analysis, invoicing, or reconciliation processes
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.

The Metropolitan Transportation Authority is North America's largest transportation network, serving a population of 15\.3 million people across a 5,000\-square\-mile travel area surrounding New York City, Long Island, southeastern New York State, and Connecticut. The MTA network comprises the nation’s largest bus fleet and more subway and commuter rail cars than all other U.S. transit systems combined. **Job Summary****:**


The Performance and Strategy Analyst Level I supports the Office of Consolidated Pensions by driving operational excellence, elevating performance measurement, and advancing strategic modernization initiatives across pension operations.


This role builds the analytical foundation for performance management by developing key performance indicators (KPIs) and objectives and key results (OKRs), creating data\-driven tools such as Power BI dashboards, and supporting process improvement efforts. The Data and Business Intelligence Analyst plays a critical role on the Data Analytics team \- contributing to Benchmark Education’s evolving efforts to use data and metadata to manage its growing enterprise.and connect with users and potential users around the world. * Work directly with stakeholders to understand their needs and create clear statements identifying problems and requirements
* Analyze user needs, data, and business process to model the complete lifecycle of data elements within the Benchmark technology ecosystem

* Contribute to development of advanced analytics models leveraging statistical and AI\-based techniques
* Tell effective stories about business processes through data visualization

* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant discipline, or equivalent professional experience
* Proficiency using SQL with relational databases (MySQL, SQL Server, Oracle, Postgres)
* Experience with business intelligence and reporting tools including Power BI
* Hands\-on experience building and maintaining ETL/ELT data pipelines

Benchmark Education Company (BEC) is a leading publisher of core, supplemental, and intervention literacy and language resources in English and Spanish, with valid and reliable digital assessments that inform instruction. Develop and maintain a Feasibility of Support (FOS) tracker to ensure accurate visibility of reserve unit support to exercises. Assist in tracking key readiness metrics for assigned and allocated units.

Develop and implement a standardized process to clearly define and communicate IMA Service Component roles and responsibilities, specifically focusing on transition procedures from competition to crisis. Familiarity with readiness assessment and reporting frameworks DRRS\-S and/or DRRS\-MC.

  

* Knowledge Management \& Information Management: Develop and maintain a centralized repository of relevant policies, procedures, and best practices related to reserve integration, readiness, and GFM processes. Act as a key point of contact for information related to each topic.

  

* Coordination \& Liaison: Assist in coordinating with Marine Forces Reserve (MARFORRES), HQMC, other Service Components, and relevant stakeholders to facilitate reserve force activations, allocations, and readiness assessments.

  

* Process Improvement: Identify and recommend improvements to existing reserve integration, readiness reporting, and GFM processes to enhance efficiency and effectiveness.

  

* Documentation: Create and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and other documentation related to reserve integration, readiness, and GFM activities.

Support exercise planning and execution by coordinating reserve unit participation and tracking associated requirements. Experience with SMDS/GSAMPS (formally known as FMT).

Reporting directly to senior leadership, the Business Analyst will play a key role in helping L\&L Franchise, Inc. understand its business performance and identify opportunities for growth and improvement. jobs.title: Program Manager, Strategy & Operations (Remote)
jobs.description:
We are seeking a **Program Manager, Strategy \& Operations** to join the Office of the President. In this role, you will serve as the quarterback for our Annual Operating Plan (AOP) and Objectives and Key Results (OKRs), driving the disciplined execution and operational excellence required to meet Aledade’s strategic priorities.
  

As a strategic operator and internal consultant, you will partner with leaders across the organization to turn high\-level vision into actionable outcomes. You will be instrumental in bridging the gap between strategy and execution—fostering cross\-functional collaboration, proactively addressing roadblocks, and ensuring our teams remain aligned with our most ambitious goals.
  

This is a unique opportunity to gain direct exposure to senior leadership while developing your operational toolkit. By ensuring our business objectives are translated into successful results, you will contribute directly to Aledade’s mission of empowering independent primary care.

We are flexible with respect to geographic location, and the ideal candidate will be comfortable working remotely/work from home within the US or be based from Bethesda, MD office.

**Primary Duties:**
-------------------



### **Performance Management:**

* **Drive Accountability:** Own the end\-to\-end performance management of AOP Objectives and Key Results, ensuring owners are empowered and accountable for delivering on their targets.
* **Maintain Operational Tempo:** Act as the heartbeat of the AOP, ensuring consistent progress through proactive follow\-ups, closing feedback loops, and keeping cross\-functional workstreams on schedule.
* **Surface \& Mitigate Risk:** Early\-identify systemic risks or operational blockers to OKR success; partner with teams to develop mitigation strategies and escalate critical issues to leadership to ensure a path forward.

### **Strategic \& Annual Planning:**

* **Lead Planning Cycles:** Facilitate the departmental annual planning process and mid\-year (2H) adjustments, ensuring departmental goals remain ambitious yet realistic.
* **Continue to Build the Playbook:** Continuously refine and document the AOP Playbook at Aledade, codifying best practices to make each planning cycle more efficient and predictable than the last.
* **QBR Preparation:** Partner with department Ops Leads to prepare high\-quality materials and narratives for Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), ensuring a data\-driven story of progress and challenges.

### **Cross\-Functional Orchestration \& Alignment:**

* **Stakeholder Management:** Build deep, trust\-based relationships across the organization to facilitate honest discussions regarding progress, resource gaps, and cross\-departmental dependencies.
* **Early Alignment Integration:** Act as the "glue" between departments, ensuring that initiatives have early and consistent alignment with Analytics, Field, and Product stakeholders.
* **Cross\-Functional Bridge:** Serve as the central point of contact to ensure that changes in one department’s roadmap are communicated and reconciled with the broader AOP.

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 5\+ years progressive experience in operations, strategy, program management or consulting
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience

### **Preferred knowledge, skills, and/or abilities:**

* Master’s degree preferred
* Proven ability to build strong relationships, influence without authority, and effectively collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including senior leaders.
* Demonstrated experience in managing projects, tracking performance, and driving execution in a complex environment.  

Ability to think critically, identify issues, and develop actionable strategic solutions.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate complex information to diverse audiences and influence stakeholders.
* Self\-motivated, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability for outcomes.

### **Physical Requirements:**


* Sitting for prolonged periods of time. Extensive use of computers and keyboard. Occasional walking and lifting may be required.
**Who We Are:**
Aledade PBC, a public benefit corporation, exists to empower the most transformational part of our health care landscape \- independent primary care. We were founded in 2014, and since then, we've become the largest network of independent primary care in the country \- helping practices, health centers and clinics deliver better care to their patients and thrive in value\-based care. Additionally, by creating value\-based contracts across a wide variety of health plans, we aim to flip the script on the traditional fee\-for\-service model. Our work strengthens continuity of care, aligns incentives and ensures primary care physicians are paid for what they do best \- keeping patients healthy. If you want to help create a health care system that is good for patients, good for practices and good for society \- and if you're eager to join a collaborative, inclusive and remote\-first culture \- you've come to the right place.

**What Does This Mean for You?**
At Aledade PBC, you will be part of a creative culture that is driven by a passion for tackling complex issues with respect, open\-mindedness and a desire to learn. You will collaborate with team members who bring a wide range of experiences, interests, backgrounds, beliefs and achievements to their work \- and who are all united by a shared passion for public health and a commitment to the Aledade mission.

In addition to time off to support work\-life balance and enjoyment, we offer the following comprehensive benefits package designed for the overall well\-being of our team members:

Flexible work schedules and the ability to work remotely are available for many roles
Health, dental and vision insurance paid up to 80% for employees, dependents and domestic partners

jobs.description:
##### **About Peraton**


Peraton is a next\-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.


##### **About The Role**


Peraton is currently hiring a **Jr Industrial Control System Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst** for its Federal Strategic Cyber programs.

  

**Location: On\-site in Arlington, VA.**

  

**About the Role:**

  

As a Jr Industrial Control System Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst, you will play a vital role in safeguarding critical infrastructure by integrating multiple intelligence sources to create actionable insights and recommendations. You will support operational teams and senior leaders by investigating and analyzing cyber threats specific to operational technology environments.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**


* Fuse multiple intelligence sources to develop comprehensive products, recommendations, and prioritize organizational focus.
* Research and investigate current threats in operational technology (OT), critical infrastructure sectors, and mission areas.
* Analyze data to derive insights on adversary capabilities, intentions, tactics, and behaviors in relation to critical infrastructure attacks.
* Research and review cyber warfare tactics, techniques, and procedures affecting information networks.
* Prepare assessments and threat profiles related to ICS/SCADA systems based on recent trends.
* Escalate new or high\-priority threats to the Cyber Physical Forensics Section as needed.
* Investigate OT defensive tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) for threat detection and response.
* Map ICS activities and threats using the MITRE ATT\&CK Framework.
* Collaborate with host, network, and cloud forensic analysts to support incident response and threat hunting missions.
* Identify potential open\-source vulnerabilities within ICS/SCADA environments.
* Assess emerging threats and vulnerabilities related to homeland security.
* Analyze classified threat intelligence reports concerning ICS/SCADA to evaluate adversary intent and capability.
* Produce high\-quality papers, presentations, and recommendations for senior US government intelligence and operations officials.
##### **Qualifications**


**Minimum Qualifications:** **LU**


* Bachelor’s degree and 2 years of experience, or Associate’s degree and 4 years, or High School diploma and 6\+ years of relevant experience in lieu of a degree.
* Hands\-on experience in processing, triage, threat analysis, and responding to cyber incident reports.
* Demonstrated ability to research and analyze cyber threats across multiple industries or timeframes, including critical infrastructure sectors.
* Familiarity with cyber threat intelligence tools such as DomainTools, VirusTotal, SHODAN, etc..
* Proven experience producing all\-source (unclassified and classified) finished intelligence assessments aligned with ICD203 analytic tradecraft standards.
* Demonstrated strong collaboration skills and ability to build key threat intelligence partnerships to enhance information sharing and cyber defenses.
* U.S. citizenship is required.
* Active Top Secret Security Clearance with SCI eligibility.
	+ Ability to obtain and maintain DHS EOD agency clearance prior to start.

**Preferred Qualifications:**


* SANS Global Industrial Cyber Security Professional (GICSP).
* SANS GIAC Response and Industrial Defense (GRID).
* SANS GIAC Cyber Threat Intelligence (GCTI).
##### **Details**


**Target Salary Range:** $86,000 \- $138,000\. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.


**Benefits Statement:** Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at https://www.careers.peraton.com/benefits.


**Application Statements:** The application period for the job is estimated to be 30 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. By applying to this job, you are expressing interest in the role and the Company. During the review of your application, you may be required to participate in an on\-camera interview, as well as participate in a process to verify your identity. Use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools of any kind during Peraton interviews is strictly prohibited unless the candidate has obtained prior written authorization. All interview responses must be the candidate’s own.

Overview

Cybersecure11 is seeking a technically skilled and detail\-oriented **Cybersecurity Operations Analyst** to support security monitoring, threat detection, vulnerability management, incident response, and security assessment activities.

The Cybersecurity Operations Analyst will work with security tools and monitoring platforms to identify suspicious activity, investigate alerts, document security events, and support incident response and threat\-hunting operations. The ideal candidate has a strong interest in defensive cybersecurity, excellent analytical skills, and the ability to respond effectively to evolving cyber threats.

Cybersecure11 provides managed security services, SOC monitoring, threat intelligence, vulnerability assessments, penetration testing, incident response, digital forensics, and GRC consulting services.

Responsibilities

* Monitor security alerts, network activity, endpoints, applications, and infrastructure for suspicious or potentially malicious activity
* Analyze and triage security events generated by SIEM, EDR, IDS/IPS, firewall, endpoint, and network\-security platforms
* Investigate potential security incidents and escalate confirmed or high\-risk events according to established incident\-response procedures
* Support threat\-hunting activities designed to identify indicators of compromise and previously undetected threats
* Assist with incident response, containment, investigation, remediation, and post\-incident documentation
* Analyze logs, authentication activity, network traffic, endpoint telemetry, and other security data
* Support vulnerability assessment and penetration\-testing teams by documenting findings and tracking remediation activities

Summary
  
Balfour Beatty Construction, LLC (Company), a member of the Balfour Beatty plc group of companies, is searching for a CMMC Program Manager to support its compliance with cyber and physical security requirements for Federal Contract Information (FCI) and Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) associated with the Company’s Federal construction contracts, as well as equivalent requirements in private contracts. The CMMC Program Manager is responsible for managing, maintaining, and continuously improving the organization's Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC) compliance program for the secure enclave supporting Department of Defense (DoD) and other Federal agency CUI, as well as the Company’s policies and procedures for handling FCI. The CMMC Program Manager will serve as the primary liaison between compliance \& ethics, IT, legal, and operations as it relates to governance, reporting, monitoring, assessment and organizational adoption of security requirements necessary to maintain ongoing compliance with NIST SP 800\-171, NIST SP 800\-137, FAR and DFARS requirements, and CMMC Level 1 and Level 2\.

* Serve as the organization's primary internal authority for CMMC compliance within the secure enclave, providing guidance to IT, IT Security, Operations, Human Resources, Legal, Procurement, Communications and executive leadership regarding FCI, CUI and equivalent compliance obligations and governance requirements.
* Own the organization's CMMC compliance program for the secure enclave, ensuring governance activities remain aligned with organizational objectives, contractual obligations, regulatory requirements, and evolving cybersecurity risks.

* Develop and maintain evidence repositories supporting ongoing internal assessments, external certification activities, and audit readiness.
* Ensure compliance documentation—including the System Security Plan (SSP), POA\&Ms, policies, procedures, system inventories, data flow diagrams, asset inventories, evidence repositories, and assessment records—remains complete, accurate, and current.
* Track, report, coordinate, and validate remediation of deviations, exceptions, and findings discovered during monitoring or risk assessments.
* Prepare metrics dashboards and executive reports summarizing enclave risk posture and compliance trends.
* Coordinate compliance activities involving third\-party service providers supporting the enclave, including review of agreements, security documentation, and shared responsibility requirements.
* Review proposed changes to enclave architecture, systems, applications, and operational processes to evaluate potential impacts to CMMC compliance and update compliance documentation as necessary.
* Coordinate with IT Operations and IT Security teams to ensure configuration baselines, asset inventories, and system changes remain aligned with approved security configurations and compliance requirements.
* Coordinate or participate in periodic incident response tabletop exercises involving IT, Legal, Human Resources, Executive Leadership, and applicable business stakeholders.

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager, Site Deployment - Mechanical Design Assurance, NA
jobs.description:
**About Vantage Data Centers**
==============================

  

Vantage Data Centers powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well\-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands.

**Reliability Engineering**  

The Reliability Engineering Department is responsible for ensuring the operational health of critical systems and the implementation of Site Operations best practices. This includes evaluating the performance and reliability of critical infrastructure, maintaining operational availability through maintenance programs, and providing technical support to Site Operations teams. The department also collaborates closely with the Design Engineering team to provide feedback for future data center designs.

**Position Overview**

**This role will be based near any of our North America office locations, following our flexible work policy (3 days in\-office and 2 days flexible).**

The Sr. Technical Project Manager, Site Deployment \- Mechanical Design Assurance is responsible for providing operationally focused mechanical review and technical assurance for new data center builds, expansions, and major fit\-out projects across the North America portfolio. This role represents Site Operations and Site Deployment during design development, page\-turn reviews, submittal reviews, RFI responses, commissioning strategy alignment, and movement of design packages toward Issued for Construction drawings.  

The position ensures that mechanical systems are designed and delivered in a manner that is operable, maintainable, safe, reliable, and aligned with long\-term Mission Critical Operations requirements. Working closely with Design Engineering, Construction, Commissioning, Business Operations, and local Site Operations teams, this role brings operator perspective into design decisions before construction execution, procurement, and turnover activities create downstream operational risk.

 **Essential Job Functions**

* Serve as the primary Site Deployment representative for mechanical design assurance across assigned campuses, projects, and expansions.
* Participate in design page\-turn reviews and provide operator\-focused comments from concept design through IFC drawing issuance.
* Review mechanical design packages, narratives, specifications, sequences of operation, equipment schedules, and drawing sets for operability, maintainability, accessibility, and reliability.
* Review mechanical submittals, equipment selections, vendor documentation, and proposed alternates to evaluate operational impact, maintenance requirements, and lifecycle risk.
* Support responses to RFIs related to mechanical systems, equipment access, operating modes, redundancy, controls interfaces, maintenance clearances, and long\-term serviceability.
* Evaluate value engineering proposals and design changes to ensure critical operational requirements are not removed, reduced, or compromised without appropriate risk visibility.
* Provide technical input for mechanical commissioning strategies, operational acceptance criteria, testing scripts, TAB requirements, integrated systems testing, and turnover readiness expectations.
* Collaborate with Site Deployment TPMs and future MCO teams to ensure mechanical design intent is carried forward into construction, commissioning, training, CMMS population, and steady\-state operations.
* Capture lessons learned from active operating sites and deployment projects and feed them back into future mechanical design standards, templates, and review criteria.

**Duties and Responsibilities**

* Review mechanical design milestones including 30%, 60%, 90%, IFC, bulletin, and construction revision packages.
* Assess chilled water plants, CRAH/CRAC systems, pumps, piping, valves, heat exchangers, cooling towers, dry coolers, economization systems, filtration, water treatment, controls, and associated support infrastructure.
* Validate maintenance access, equipment clearances, rigging paths, valve accessibility, isolation strategy, redundancy philosophy, and operational workflows within mechanical spaces.
* Track design review comments, assigned actions, and open mechanical issues through closure with Design Engineering, Construction, Commissioning, and Site Operations stakeholders.
* Participate in recurring design coordination meetings, page turns, constructability reviews, operability reviews, and commissioning planning sessions.
* Review MEP coordination impacts where mechanical systems interface with electrical, controls, fire protection, architectural, structural, and civil scopes.
* Provide operator perspective on sequence of operations, controls strategy, sensor placement, alarm strategy, setpoints, trending capability, and emergency operating scenarios.
* Review proposed equipment substitutions or manufacturer deviations for potential impacts to maintainability, spare parts, training, warranty, resilience, and operational standardization.
* Support development of operational design standards, mechanical review checklists, lessons learned repositories, and acceptance criteria used by the Site Deployment organization.
* Partner with local MCO leadership to ensure future operators understand mechanical design intent, operating limitations, maintenance requirements, and known risk items prior to turnover.

**Job Requirements**

* 5\+ years of experience in data center operations, mechanical engineering, commissioning, critical facilities maintenance, construction QA/QC, or mission\-critical infrastructure delivery.
* Strong working knowledge of data center mechanical systems, including chilled water, airside cooling, pumping systems, mechanical controls, water treatment, and supporti

### **Position Description \& Qualifications**

  

  

Serco is excited to continue support to the F\-35 Joint Strike Fighter Program Office (JPO). This contract provides program management support in support of the full acquisition lifecycle of the F\-35 program, to include development, production, and sustainment.


Our **Foreign Military Sales (FMS) Program Analyst**, located in Crystal City, Arlington, VA, provides program management support to the Propulsion Program Management Office (PMO) in acquiring, supporting, and improving the family of F135 engines produced by Pratt \& Whitney (P\&W). You will be part of a dynamic team of F\-35 JPO Program Analysts and Program/Project Managers who works closely with the customer and other key F\-35 National Security and Allied stakeholders to deliver quality F\-35 systems.


In this role, you will:


* Assist Propulsion PMO in managing cost, schedule, and performance for F135 across development, production, and sustainment.
* Assist Propulsion PMO in serving as propulsion system integrator for the F\-35 Air System.
* Assist Propulsion PMO in managing propulsions systems risks.
* Assist Propulsion PMO in sustaining engines for U.S. Services, Partners, and FMS customers.
* Assist Propulsion PMO in managing production out of three assembly plants.
* Assist Propulsion PMO in managing F\-135 Component Improvement Program (CIP).
* Support Propulsion PMO in delivering the following key products:
	+ Component Improvement Program – assist Propulsion PMO in addressing Propulsion Safety, Reliability, and Readiness issues; (b).
	+ Propulsion Sustainment, Production, and CIP Contracts.
	+ F\-35 Propulsion Systems – Power Module, Fan Module, Lift System, and major Line\-Replaceable Units (LRU).
	+ Propulsion Support Equipment.

To be successful in this role, you will have:


* The ability to provide onsite support at F\-35 Joint Program Office (JPO) located in Crystal City, VA no less than 2 days per week, each week. Exact days in office at the JPO must be coordinated with F\-35 customer and approved by your Serco manager. (Your onsite days in JPO office including adhoc meetings may increase to support the needs of the customer).
* An active Secret Security clearance.
* A Bachelor's degree and 3 years of recent work experience related to international acquisition programs (total of 6 years)
	+ OR an Associates degree plus 4 years of additional work experience (total of 10 years of work experience).
* Experience in defense acquisition program management related to weapon systems acquisition and life\-cycle management.
* Familiarity with DoD Instruction (DoDI) 5000\.2, DoD Directive (DODD) 5530\.03 (International Agreements), and the International Cooperation in Acquisition, Technology and Logistics (IC in AT\&L) Handbook.
* Demonstrated knowledge of the principles, policies, and practices of system acquisition to plan, organize, and coordinate critical aspects of the development, production, deployment, and sustainment of systems, subsystems, and equipment.
* Demonstrated knowledge of the Security Assistance/Security Cooperation (SA/SC) programs to include the understanding of the FMS sales process from case development, implementation, execution, to closure in accordance with the Security Assistance Management Manual (SAMM), DoD 5105\.38\-MX.
* The ability to travel up to 25% (CONUS and OCONUS)

Additional desired experience and skills:


* Experience of creating products and working in Microsoft Office Suite\- Microsoft Word, Microsoft Excel (data types, formulas, and functions in the workbooks), Microsoft Powerpoint, Microsoft Outlook, and Microsoft TEAMS.

Serco Inc. (Serco) is the Americas division of Serco Group, plc.
