jobs.description:
Principal Data Analyst
At Capital One, data is at the center of everything we do. When we launched as a startup we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast\-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data\-driven decision\-making.

  

As a Data Analyst at Capital One you will leverage analytic and technical skills to innovate, build, and maintain well\-managed data solutions and capabilities to tackle business problems.

  

On any given day you will be challenged on three types of work – Innovation, Business Intelligence and Data Management:

  

Innovation

* Use Open Source/Digital technologies to mine complex, voluminous, and different varieties of data sources and platforms
* Build well\-managed data solutions, tools, and capabilities to enable self\-service frameworks for data consumers
* Demonstrate ability to explore and quickly grasp new technologies to progress varied initiatives

  

Business Intelligence

* Partner with the business to provide consultancy and translate the business needs to design and develop tools, techniques, metrics, and dashboards for insights and data visualization
* Drive analysis that provides meaningful insights on business strategies

  

Data Management

* Drive an understanding and adherence to the principles of data quality management including metadata, lineage, and business definitions
* Work collaboratively with appropriate Tech teams to manage security mechanisms and data access governance
* Build and execute tools to monitor and report on data quality

  

Our ideal candidate will have:

* Degree specialized in a Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics discipline
* Scripting experience in (Python, R, Spark, and SQL)
* Strong desire and experience with data in various forms (data warehouses/SQL, unstructured data)
* Experience utilizing and developing within AWS services

* Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Bachelor’s Degree in quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science or a related quantitative field) plus at least 5 years of experience performing data analytics, or, a Master’s Degree plus at least 3 years performing data analytics with an expectation that required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date.
* At least 3 years of experience working with at least one scripting language
* At least 3 years of experience utilizing a business intelligence visualization tool
* At least 3 years of experience in querying, analyzing and working with data languages and platforms


Preferred Qualifications:

* Master’s Degree in a Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics discipline

jobs.description:
**Who We Are:**


Headquartered in Washington, DC, Versar Global Solutions provides full mission lifecycle solutions for challenges faced by our government and commercial Customers in the natural, built, and digital environments. With team members around the world and a rich legacy spanning more than 50 years, Versar Global Solutions delivers a broad array of planning, analysis and risk management solutions, project and program management, operations and maintenance services, and information technology applications for environmental management and remediation projects, mission critical facilities and installations, and in support of readiness and contingency operations.

**Who You Are:**


Versar is seeking a highly analytical and detail\-oriented Senior Business Operations Analyst to provide financial and operational oversight for a portfolio of government and commercial projects. This role serves as a key business partner to Project Managers, Operations Leadership, Contracts, and Finance, ensuring financial integrity, compliance, and successful execution of project activities throughout the project lifecycle.


The Senior Business Operations Analyst is responsible for project setup, funding management, billing, revenue and cost analysis, forecasting, month\-end close activities, financial reporting, and portfolio performance monitoring. This position plays a critical role in supporting strategic decision\-making by providing accurate financial analysis and actionable insights into leadership.

**What You’ll Do:**


This role serves as a critical link between Operations, Finance, Contracts, and Project Management to ensure the successful financial performance and operational execution of Versar's project portfolio.


The successful Senior Business Operations Analyst will:

* Maintain accurate financial oversight of assigned project portfolio.
* Deliver timely and accurate invoices and financial reporting.
* Proactively identify project risks and funding constraints.
* Improve forecast accuracy and project profitability.
* Ensure compliance with contractual and company requirements.
* Support successful month\-end close and audit readiness.
* Act as a trusted financial advisor to project and operational leadership.

**Financial Management \& Analysis**

* Manage the financial administration of a portfolio of projects from contract award through project closeout.
* Monitor project financial performance, including revenue, direct costs, indirect costs, profitability, and cash flow.

The Engineering Technical Program Manager (TPM) will drive complex, cross\-functional engineering initiatives from conception to deployment, managing timelines, mitigating risks, and ensuring technical scalability. The TPM will evaluate complex systems and identify, quantify, and mitigate potential design, manufacturing or project execution failures. Conduct analysis to ensure designs meets technical, manufacturability and reliability objectives and compliance to industry standards using methods such as FTA, FMEA, and probabilistic risk assessments. * Perform qualitative and quantitative risk analyses, including Fault Tree Analysis (FTA), Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA), and Hazard and Operability Studies (HAZOP)
* Ensure engineering designs comply with industry regulations, international safety standards (e.g., ISO, IEC), and corporate governance policies
* Develop and recommend actionable risk mitigation strategies, design modifications, or operational controls to minimize identified hazards
* Collaborate with testing and validation teams to verify that risk controls are effective and appropriately integrated into the final design
* Author comprehensive risk management plans and analytical reports for executive stakeholders and external customers
* Serve as the primary technical advisor, bridging the gap between design engineers, project managers, and manufacturing
* Mentor engineers, technicians, and production staff on risk analysis best practices.

**Basic (required) Qualifications:**

* Minimum of a Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Aerospace, Systems, or Reliability Engineering (Master's or Ph.D. preferred).
* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in engineering design, systems safety, or reliability analysis within highly regulated industries (e.g., aerospace, automotive, nuclear, or medical devices)
* Deep proficiency in probabilistic risk assessment (PRA), Monte Carlo simulations, and reliability modeling software (e.g., ReliaSoft, Item ToolKit, or PTC Windchill).
* 5\+ years analyzing and interpreting complex engineering data and statistical risks into clear, non\-technical language for strategic decision\-making

jobs.description:
#### **About Us**


sunday is building the fastest, simplest way to pay in restaurants. With a quick scan of a QR code, diners can pay, tip, and leave in about 10 seconds. We believe great products should feel obvious, not complicated, and we focus relentlessly on keeping things **simple** while earning **trust** from restaurants and guests at every interaction. Today, sunday powers payments in thousands of restaurants across the US, UK, and France, helping operators turn tables faster, increase tips, and unlock valuable insights. As a Strategy Analyst assisting our European GM, you will be at the core of how sunday runs, measures, and improves its operations. This is an international role — you will work across the European markets (France and UK), with exposure to global Senior Leadership as sunday scales.


You will collaborate cross\-functionally with Operations, Finance, Customer Experience, Data and RevOps to build the analytical foundation that drives better decisions across the company.


This is not a reporting role. You will own end\-to\-end analyses, surface insights that challenge assumptions and guide decisions, and help build the operational infrastructure that allows sunday to scale efficiently.


You will be based in Paris with 3 days/week in office minimum.

* Own operational reporting and performance tracking — build, maintain, and improve dashboards and reports that give leadership and teams a clear, real\-time view of business health.

jobs.title: Expert People Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Requisition ID \# 174164
  
  

**Job Category:** Business Operations / Strategy
  
**Job Level:** Individual Contributor
  
**Business Unit:** People
  
**Work Type:** Hybrid
  
**Job Location:** Oakland
  
  

Department Summary
  
  

The Enterprise Engagement and Culture team helps create the conditions for coworkers to thrive and for teams to perform at their best. We connect coworker insights, culture, inclusion and belonging, and performance practices to strengthen the everyday coworker experience and help the organization deliver on its Purpose, Virtues, and Stands.
  
  

The team leads enterprise strategies and programs that shape and strengthen culture, including Joy at Work, Breakthrough, and Inclusion \& Belonging. We use coworker listening, data, and insights to understand the experiences and mindsets influencing culture, identify opportunities for improvement, and help translate those insights into focused action.
  
  

Through enterprise programs, tools, and partnerships, the team helps leaders and teams strengthen connection, belonging, ownership, and performance; embed desired ways of working into the everyday coworker experience, and build the capabilities needed to turn culture into a driver of business outcomes.
  
  

Position Summary
  
  

As an Expert Data Analyst, you will play a critical role in advancing how the organization uses workforce and culture data to understand the coworker experience and drive measurable improvement. You will transform complex data into actionable enterprise insights by identifying trends, patterns, relationships, and emerging opportunities that extend beyond traditional reporting.
  
  

In this role, you will partner with leaders and cross\-functional teams to translate findings into clear recommendations, identify where targeted interventions and resources can have the greatest impact, and establish meaningful ways to measure progress over time. Through advanced analytics, visualization, and storytelling, you will help leaders move from understanding what the data says to understanding why it matters, where to focus, and what actions are most likely to improve outcomes.
  
  

The role is hybrid working from your remote office and in\-person at Oakland General Office, 2\-3x per month based on business needs.
  
  

Job Responsibilities
  
Performs analysis on highly complex data models that have cross\- functional impact. Applies advanced knowledge to a wide range of business issues. Develop innovative data solutions to address complex business issues. Presents findings and proposed recommendations to leaders. Develop business cases in support of strategy or change initiatives. Works with and leverages relationships with Directors and Managers across functions / PG\&E. Manages cross\-functional projects or initiatives. May provide direction and coaching to other Business Analysts.
  
  

Qualifications
  
  

**Minimum:**  

Bachelor’s degree in business administration or job\-related field or equivalent experience 6 years of related work experience Demonstrated ability to create Lean visual management
  
  

**Desired:**  

Extensive knowledge of different analytical methods, approaches, and tactics Broad expertise in what\-if modeling analysis, concepts, methods and techniques and analysis of how different factors affect business outcomes Creative problem\-solving skills to develop solutions Strong analytical and writing skills to create compelling business cases based on complex business environments and inputs Influence skills to effectively gain buy in from leaders inside and outside of the department Knowledge and understanding of key drivers affecting business results Project management skills to lead large and complex projects working with cross\-functional teams Organizational, prioritization and multitasking skills Adaptable to changing business conditions and ambiguity Advanced skills in Microsoft Office, Project, Visio, or similar software
  
  

Compensation
  
  

PG\&E is providing the full salary/pay range for this position. The actual amount paid to an individual will be based on multiple factors, including, but not limited to, internal equity, specific skills, education, licenses or certifications, experience, market value, and geographic location. The range to reasonably expect will be around the minimum and the midpoint of the range. The final decision will be made on a case\-by\-case basis related to the factors above. This job is also eligible to participate in PG\&E’s discretionary incentive compensation programs.
  
**Bay Area Min:** $122,000 Bay Area Mid: $158,000 Bay Area Max: $194,000

The Immigrant Legal Resource Center (ILRC) is seeking a full\-time **Project Manager** in our San Francisco, CA headquarters. This is an exempt position that reports to a Directing Attorney. This is a bargaining unit position represented by the National Legal Services Workers (NOLSW), Local 2320\. **This is a term\-limited position through December 31, 2028, with the potential for renewal based on funding.**

  


**The ILRC currently has a hybrid work model requiring two in\-office days per week.**

The ILRC is a leading immigrant rights organization headquartered in San Francisco with staff in Washington, D.C., Texas, Southern California, the Central Valley of California, and Washington state. Since 1979, our mission has been to educate, support, and empower immigrants, community organizations, and legal practitioners to build a more just, inclusive, and democratic society. Our team is passionate, collaborative, and committed to equity and innovation in all we do. Additional information about our organizational values is available here.

  


**The Opportunity:**

Integrity – Collaboration \- Relationships – Excellence – Creativity \- Results

Concentric \- "Your World Secured"

jobs.title: Technical and Access Services Project Manager and Process Analyst
jobs.description:
Stanford University Libraries is seeking a full\-time Technical and Access Services Project Manager to manage divisional and inter\-divisional projects and process improvements. The Libraries values are rooted in a commitment of mutual respect, the idea that every member of the staff has something to contribute, and that learning is constant. We seek a team member who is ready to share their skills and perspectives.  



**About Stanford University Libraries:**

Stanford University Libraries is a network of over 15 libraries with over 400 employees. We are committed to fueling the teaching, learning and research across Stanford by acquiring, stewarding, and making available a robust collection, currently in excess of 12 million items. Everyone in the organization plays a vital role in fulfilling that objective. Our dedication to discoverability and information management also has us engaged in dynamic global partnerships. We are constantly building and strengthening our organization, and we recognize striving for excellence is a marathon and not a sprint. We are constantly trying to strike the right pace and admit there are times when we find ourselves at a fast jog. While we hope to always find candidates who fit within our organization, what we truly seek is someone who will add to our culture, our profession as well as the greater academic arena. We are invested in the success of our teams and the individuals who represent Stanford University Libraries.  



**About Technical and Access Services:**

The Technical and Access Services division within Stanford University Libraries consists of five departments: Access Services, Acquisitions and Collection Services, Metadata Services, Preservation, and Remote Storage. With both patron\-facing and back\-office responsibilities, these departments function interdependently and collaborate to ensure access to library resources in a variety of formats and languages. Over 120 staff members acquire, describe, preserve, and provide access to all types of library materials. We work in Palo Alto, Redwood City, Livermore, and remotely across the country.  



**About the Position:**

Reporting to the AUL for Technical and Access Services, the Technical and Access Services Project Manager will manage a wide range of complex projects and may manage more than one large project simultaneously.  



Projects will involve multiple departments within Technical and Access Services and may include stakeholders from other library divisions. The Project Manager will collaborate with senior management and department leadership to select and define projects that support divisional priorities. Projects include the design and implementation of new or updated services as well as process improvements to enhance divisional impact and effectiveness.  



In coordination with others on any given project, develops metrics and KPIs appropriate for tracking and reporting progress.  



While most of the position is focused on project leadership, the Project Manager will also be a technical contributor in areas including assessment, business analysis, facilitation, and documentation.  



Approved budgeted annual salary not to exceed: $183,098 per annum


  
**Core Duties** :


* Perform the full range of project management cycle: initiating, planning, executing, monitoring and controlling, and closing. Independently lead and direct projects requiring high levels of functional integration and involving multiple disciplines to be managed.
* Direct development of an action plan, and estimate requirements for resources, including management, labor, materials, and time required to complete project.
* Facilitate discussions and negotiations to drive recommendation consensus.
* Develop and help execute comprehensive change management strategy and communication plan relative to project scope and stakeholders; orchestrate and lead change management methodologies underlying project success.
These elements typically delineate the project management involved at this level: charter origination or scope identification and shaping, scope definition; \# of disciplines /stakeholders to manage is across\-university impact, and city, county constituents; risk\-manage, control and report on risk associated with more complicated projects, affecting division or program as it relates to their project portfolio and risk sharing and control is skewed further to the project manager; project complexity involves synthesizing complex technical data and driving decisions; primary university relationship is at the senior associate/administrative dean, faculty and directors level; typical cumulative budget/scope from $250k to $1 million.  
* 

**Minimum Education** :


Bachelor's degree in a related field


**Minimum Experience** :


Five years of related experience in management of projects with extensive size/complexity and moderate performance risk, including project planning, scheduling, tracking, and budgeting, or a combination of education and experience.


**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities** :


* Highly effective written and oral communication skills to address a wide variety of audiences.
* Ability to productively assemble, engage, and lead cross\-functional teams.
* Demonstrated project management ability to employ integration, scope time management, cost, quality, human resources, communications, risk, and procurement components.
* Ability to balance customer expectations with project reality.
* Demonstrated resilience, diplomacy, influence, relationship building, and problem\-solving skills in a variety of situations.
* Keen grasp of interpersonal and impact awareness.
* Depth of knowledge in technical discipline/domain needed to deliver projects.

jobs.title: Assistant Project Manager

Our work spans the Life Sciences, Energy, and Government sectors, where we deliver comprehensive management and advisory services. We serve as an unbiased advocate for our clients, providing leadership and strategic guidance to navigate complex real estate challenges while minimizing risk and maximizing outcomes.

As we continue to expand our portfolio of exciting projects in Northern California, we are seeking a passionate Assistant Project Manager to join our growing team and deliver exceptional outcomes for our clients. This role will help lead capital projects as the owner’s representative, bringing comprehensive knowledge of the real estate development lifecycle, approval processes, and regulatory requirements.

The Assistant Project Manager will support the development and maintenance of strong client relationships, serving as a key point of coordination for internal stakeholders and external partners. In this role, you will assist in facilitating clear communication, contributing to strategic decision\-making, and supporting efforts to enhance the performance of the client’s real estate assets. If you thrive in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment, bring a proactive and detail\-oriented mindset, and are passionate about delivering exceptional results while growing within a forward\-thinking firm, we invite you to join Epicus Group.

**Your Role:** 

As an Assistant Project Manager, you will interface with Epicus clients and project teams through a successful process of strategic real estate planning, design, and construction of new buildings, tenant improvement buildouts, and facilities assignments. Some of the ways you will support our projects are:

This includes evaluating the performance and reliability of critical infrastructure, maintaining operational availability through maintenance programs, and providing technical support to Site Operations teams. The department also collaborates closely with the Design Engineering team to provide feedback for future data center designs.

**This role will be based near any of our North America office locations, following our flexible work policy (3 days in\-office and 2 days flexible).**

The Sr. Technical Project Manager, Site Deployment \- Mechanical Design Assurance is responsible for providing operationally focused mechanical review and technical assurance for new data center builds, expansions, and major fit\-out projects across the North America portfolio. This role represents Site Operations and Site Deployment during design development, page\-turn reviews, submittal reviews, RFI responses, commissioning strategy alignment, and movement of design packages toward Issued for Construction drawings.  

The position ensures that mechanical systems are designed and delivered in a manner that is operable, maintainable, safe, reliable, and aligned with long\-term Mission Critical Operations requirements. Working closely with Design Engineering, Construction, Commissioning, Business Operations, and local Site Operations teams, this role brings operator perspective into design decisions before construction execution, procurement, and turnover activities create downstream operational risk.

* Serve as the primary Site Deployment representative for mechanical design assurance across assigned campuses, projects, and expansions.

* Review mechanical submittals, equipment selections, vendor documentation, and proposed alternates to evaluate operational impact, maintenance requirements, and lifecycle risk.
* Support responses to RFIs related to mechanical systems, equipment access, operating modes, redundancy, controls interfaces, maintenance clearances, and long\-term serviceability.
* Evaluate value engineering proposals and design changes to ensure critical operational requirements are not removed, reduced, or compromised without appropriate risk visibility.
* Provide technical input for mechanical commissioning strategies, operational acceptance criteria, testing scripts, TAB requirements, integrated systems testing, and turnover readiness expectations.
* Collaborate with Site Deployment TPMs and future MCO teams to ensure mechanical design intent is carried forward into construction, commissioning, training, CMMS population, and steady\-state operations.
* Capture lessons learned from active operating sites and deployment projects and feed them back into future mechanical design standards, templates, and review criteria.

**Duties and Responsibilities**

* Review mechanical design milestones including 30%, 60%, 90%, IFC, bulletin, and construction revision packages.
* Assess chilled water plants, CRAH/CRAC systems, pumps, piping, valves, heat exchangers, cooling towers, dry coolers, economization systems, filtration, water treatment, controls, and associated support infrastructure.
* Validate maintenance access, equipment clearances, rigging paths, valve accessibility, isolation strategy, redundancy philosophy, and operational workflows within mechanical spaces.
* Track design review comments, assigned actions, and open mechanical issues through closure with Design Engineering, Construction, Commissioning, and Site Operations stakeholders.
* Participate in recurring design coordination meetings, page turns, constructability reviews, operability reviews, and commissioning planning sessions.
* Review MEP coordination impacts where mechanical systems interface with electrical, controls, fire protection, architectural, structural, and civil scopes.
* Provide operator perspective on sequence of operations, controls strategy, sensor placement, alarm strategy, setpoints, trending capability, and emergency operating scenarios.
* Review proposed equipment substitutions or manufacturer deviations for potential impacts to maintainability, spare parts, training, warranty, resilience, and operational standardization.
* Support development of operational design standards, mechanical review checklists, lessons learned repositories, and acceptance criteria used by the Site Deployment organization.
* Partner with local MCO leadership to ensure future operators understand mechanical design intent, operating limitations, maintenance requirements, and known risk items prior to turnover.

* Strong working knowledge of data center mechanical systems, including chilled water, airside cooling, pumping systems, mechanical controls, water treatment, and supporti

jobs.title: Regulatory Program Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description:


California Water Service Group (Cal Water) invites you to build a meaningful career with the third largest publicly traded water utility in the United States. Guided by our mission to be the leading provider of water and wastewater services, we are dedicated to improving the quality of life for the customers, communities, and employees we serve. Our culture is grounded in core values—integrity, quality, service, value, health and safety, respect and collaboration, and corporate citizenship—and is reflected in our recognition as a Top Workplace®, a Great Place to Work®, and a J.D. Power leader in customer satisfaction for multiple years. Join Cal Water and be part of a purpose driven organization where your work makes a lasting impact.  

  

The Regulatory Program Manager is responsible for supporting the business case for water prices by reviewing and analyzing expenses, capital budgets, water sales, revenues, and the policies of state utility regulators necessary for the Company to provide high\-quality, reliable water service to its customers. Depending on skills and qualifications, this position can be located in San Jose or Sacramento CA.**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**

* Communicates with departments and districts to gather information for the General Rate Case (GRC)
* Collaborates with districts and departments in the Company to demonstrate a need for necessary operational expenses and provides quantifiable support
* Communicates adopted policies to districts and departments to ensure implementation in the financials and operations
* Partners closely with state agency staff to explain complex financial models in a clear and concise manner
* Determines what type of data is required, from what sources, and how to present it in the GRC
* Analyze data and reconciles discrepancies in data trends
* Flows data through complex financial models to develop a revenue requirement forecast for all regulated ratemaking districts
* Reviews district, department, and consultant testimony for completeness and accuracy
* Drafts clear and convincing testimonies to explain historical spending trends, as well as support future expense projections
* Prepares and edits the GRC responses for data requests
* Prepares offset filings including advice letters and supporting work papers; analyzes results and makes recommendations
* Coordinates all regulatory compliance filings
* Participates in and supports the Company’s Continuous Improvement programs and projects
* Performs work on site in assigned office location
* Performs other similar duties as assigned

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, Political Science, Computer Science, Economics, Engineering or related field and/or equivalent relevant experience
* Two years of increasingly responsible experience working as a regulatory or financial analyst, preferably in the water or utility industry
* Proficient in the use of Microsoft Office applications
* Valid California Driver license

**Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:**

* Knowledge of state utility regulations, the rate case process, regulatory modeling, and compliance requirements is desired
* Knowledge of Company policies, procedures, and business practices is desired
* Knowledge and understanding of the water industry and how a water utility is operated and maintained is desired
* Knowledge and ability to use Microsoft Office applications to create presentations, spreadsheets, and word documents
* Knowledge of basic finance and accounting principle and procedures
* Knowledge and understanding of utility accounting and financial concepts is desired
* Ability to use appropriate discretion when dealing with confidential or proprietary information
* Ability to work effectively with all levels of employees and middle management
* Ability to communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing with agencies, consultant, contractors, customers, employees, and vendors
* Ability to use logical and creative thought processes to develop solutions according to written specifications and/or verbal instructions
* Demonstrated organizational and time management skills
* Demonstrated commitment to providing outstanding customer service
* Detail\-oriented and experienced in analyzing and improving processes
* Good problem\-solving and troubleshooting skills

**Salary Range:**

**Sacramento, CA \- $111,400 \- $206,800 (DOE)**

**San Jose, CA $123,700 \- $230,800 (DOE)**

**Deadline to submit resume is Wednesday, September 9, 2026\.**


The Equal Opportunity Policy of the Company is based upon the philosophy that all people should be treated fairly and with dignity. California Water Service, Hawaii Water Service, New Mexico Water Service and Washington Water Service do not discriminate against any applicant or employee because of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, or any other protected class. The Company makes all employment decisions in a non\-discriminatory manner. EOE, VET, DISABILITIES.

jobs.description:
**About Us**  

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.


At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.


Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**


The Sr. Operations Analyst \- Value\-in\-Kind program is an operational role responsible for ensuring accurate, timely, and compliant execution of Value‑in‑Kind (VIK) drawdowns across the NA region. The role will primarily provide AE support for VIK workflow, with a strong focus on data accuracy, validation discipline, and rework reduction.


The role acts as a regional quality‑control layer between Sales and Finance, supporting cleaner submissions and faster execution through strong first‑time quality and operational hygiene.


This is a hybrid position. Expectation of days in office will be confirmed by your hiring manager.

**Qualifications**

**Please Note \- We are unable to provide sponsorship for this role.**

Basic Qualifications:

* 5 or more years of relevant work experience with a Bachelors Degree or at least 2 years of work experience with an Advanced degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 0 years of work experience with a PhD


Preferred Qualifications:

* 6 or more years of work experience with a Bachelors Degree or 4 or more years of relevant experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or up to 3 years of relevant experience with a PhD
* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage high‑volume transactional work accurately.
* Understanding of sales operations, deal execution, and financial controls.
* Ability to identify data issues and root causes of rework or amendments.
* Experience working with dashboards, trackers, or operational reports.
* Advanced level of excel and data analysis skills.
* Effective communication skills and ability to work cross‑functionally.

 **Information for US Applicants**


For roles located in the US, the estimated salary range for this position is $129,200 to $206,700 USD per year, which may include potential sales incentive payments (if applicable). Salary may vary depending on job\-related factors which may include knowledge, skills, experience, and location. In addition, this position may be eligible for bonus and equity.Visa has a comprehensive benefits package for which this position may be eligible that includes Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), FSA/HSA, Life Insurance, Paid Time Off, and Wellness Program.**Work Hours**


Varies upon the needs of the department.

**Travel Requirements**


This position requires travel 5\-10% of the time.

**Mental/Physical Requirements**


This position will be performed in an office setting. The position will require the incumbent to sit and stand at a desk, communicate in person and by telephone, frequently operate standard office equipment, such as telephones and computers.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**


Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protect veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the EEOC guidelines and applicable local law, including the requirements of Article 49 of the San Francisco Police Code.

**We're transforming the grocery industry**



At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.



Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.


**Instacart is a Flex First team**

There’s no one\-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in\-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

**Overview**
------------



Instacart's Customer Experience \& Operations organization is at the heart of how we support the millions of customers, shoppers, and partners who rely on our platform every day. Within that organization, the CX Technology Programs team is responsible for driving the development and deployment of technology solutions that meaningfully improve the support experience at scale.

  



We are looking for a CX Technology Program Manager to join a small, high\-impact team working at the intersection of automation, operations, and product execution. This role sits within a team of three — two individual contributors and a people manager — and will play a critical role in bringing structure, coordination, and momentum to an ambitious chatbot automation program. With 14 automations currently in active development across Shopper and Customer support programs and significant monthly cost savings on the line, this is a role where your work will have immediate, measurable business impact. If you thrive in fast\-moving environments, are energized by complexity, and know how to drive programs forward without waiting for perfect conditions, this role is for you.

  


**About the Job**
-----------------


* Own end\-to\-end planning and coordination for a portfolio of chatbot automation initiatives spanning both Shopper and Customer support programs, ensuring timelines, dependencies, and stakeholders are aligned across concurrent workstreams.
* Drive program execution in an environment where priorities shift and the roadmap evolves — you'll be the connective tissue between technical teams, operations, and leadership, keeping work moving and risks visible.
* Build and maintain the operational infrastructure for the CX Technology Programs team, including program tracking, status reporting, and cross\-functional communication rhythms that give stakeholders confidence in the work underway.
* Partner closely with product, engineering, and CX operations teams to scope, sequence, and launch automation solutions, translating business goals into clear plans with defined milestones and accountability.
* Identify gaps, surface blockers early, and propose solutions — this team is currently under\-resourced on the planning and coordination side, and you will be stepping in to immediately add structure and move critical work forward.

  


**About You**
-------------



Minimum Qualifications


* 5\+ years of experience in program management, technical program management, or operations program management, ideally within a technology, e\-commerce, or customer experience organization.
* Demonstrated experience managing multiple concurrent programs with cross\-functional stakeholders, including the ability to build and maintain program plans, track dependencies, and communicate status clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Experience working on or alongside automation, AI, or chatbot technology programs, with a working understanding of how these solutions are scoped, built, and deployed in an operational context.
* Proficiency with project and program management tools (e.g., Jira, Asana, Monday.com, or similar) and comfort using data to track progress and communicate impact.
* Proven ability to operate independently and create structure in ambiguous environments, including stepping into under\-resourced programs and quickly establishing clarity and momentum.

  



Preferred Qualifications


* Experience working within a customer support or CX technology environment, with familiarity with support operations metrics, tooling ecosystems (e.g., Salesforce, Zendesk, or similar), or automation\-driven cost reduction programs.
* Background working in a high\-growth or fast\-paced technology company where priorities evolve quickly and cross\-functional coordination spans multiple teams simultaneously.
* Experience contributing to or managing programs with measurable financial impact, such as cost savings targets, efficiency initiatives, or automation ROI tracking.
* Comfort engaging with technical concepts and product development processes, with the ability to have informed conversations with engineering and product partners without needing deep technical expertise yourself.

In this role, you will serve as the quarterback for our Annual Operating Plan (AOP) and Objectives and Key Results (OKRs), driving the disciplined execution and operational excellence required to meet Aledade’s strategic priorities.
  

As a strategic operator and internal consultant, you will partner with leaders across the organization to turn high\-level vision into actionable outcomes. You will be instrumental in bridging the gap between strategy and execution—fostering cross\-functional collaboration, proactively addressing roadblocks, and ensuring our teams remain aligned with our most ambitious goals.
  

This is a unique opportunity to gain direct exposure to senior leadership while developing your operational toolkit. By ensuring our business objectives are translated into successful results, you will contribute directly to Aledade’s mission of empowering independent primary care.

We are flexible with respect to geographic location, and the ideal candidate will be comfortable working remotely/work from home within the US or be based from Bethesda, MD office.

**Primary Duties:**
-------------------



### **Performance Management:**

* **Drive Accountability:** Own the end\-to\-end performance management of AOP Objectives and Key Results, ensuring owners are empowered and accountable for delivering on their targets.
* **Maintain Operational Tempo:** Act as the heartbeat of the AOP, ensuring consistent progress through proactive follow\-ups, closing feedback loops, and keeping cross\-functional workstreams on schedule.
* **Surface \& Mitigate Risk:** Early\-identify systemic risks or operational blockers to OKR success; partner with teams to develop mitigation strategies and escalate critical issues to leadership to ensure a path forward.

### **Strategic \& Annual Planning:**

* **Lead Planning Cycles:** Facilitate the departmental annual planning process and mid\-year (2H) adjustments, ensuring departmental goals remain ambitious yet realistic.

* **QBR Preparation:** Partner with department Ops Leads to prepare high\-quality materials and narratives for Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), ensuring a data\-driven story of progress and challenges.

### **Cross\-Functional Orchestration \& Alignment:**

* **Stakeholder Management:** Build deep, trust\-based relationships across the organization to facilitate honest discussions regarding progress, resource gaps, and cross\-departmental dependencies.
* **Early Alignment Integration:** Act as the "glue" between departments, ensuring that initiatives have early and consistent alignment with Analytics, Field, and Product stakeholders.
* **Cross\-Functional Bridge:** Serve as the central point of contact to ensure that changes in one department’s roadmap are communicated and reconciled with the broader AOP.

* 5\+ years progressive experience in operations, strategy, program management or consulting
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience

* Master’s degree preferred
* Proven ability to build strong relationships, influence without authority, and effectively collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including senior leaders.

Ability to think critically, identify issues, and develop actionable strategic solutions.

We’re looking for someone who’s naturally curious and resourceful, with a knack for uncovering hard\-to\-find insights, cutting through the noise of a crowded market, and turning scattered anecdotes into meaningful trends. You’re someone who loves to understand how things work – especially when it comes to product differentiation – and you take pride in translating that understanding into clear, actionable guidance. If you thrive on turning complexity into clarity and enjoy working cross\-functionally to drive meaningful impact, this role is for you.

### **What you’ll do**

* Design and execute a comprehensive CI strategy: monitor competitive moves, emerging threats, pricing changes, new product launches, partnerships, and market shifts in real time.
* Conduct primary (e.g. field interviews, deal\-call participation) and secondary (e.g. public filings, analyst reports, blogs, technical documentation, competitor websites) research to build a robust competitive database.
* Develop and maintain competitive enablement such as battlecards, feature‑comparison matrices, win/loss analysis summaries, objection\-handling plays, and other resources that equip sales and customer\-facing teams.
* Provide strategic support throughout the sales cycle—attending key prospect or customer calls to inject competitive perspective and help navigate head\-to\-head situations.
* Feed lessons from the field back to marketing and sales enablement to inform messaging, campaigns, and positioning adjustments—also spearheading targeted campaigns when competitor moves emerge.
* Own CI knowledge management: centralize and curate competitive intel from across the business and package insights for different internal audiences, from granular product detail to sales\-ready talking points.
* Collaborate with product teams to translate competitive and market insight into roadmap guidance and differentiation strategy.
* Evaluate competitor product architectures, translating technical findings into business\-impact assessments.
* Continuously optimize how we use competitive intelligence tools and workflows, leveraging the latest AI capabilities to increase efficiency and accuracy.

### **What experience you bring**

* 5\+ years of competitive intelligence/strategy in enterprise B2B SaaS
* Domain expertise in fraud prevention, AML/KYC compliance, cybersecurity, or related field.
* Experience creating and managing a centralized CI knowledge base that scales across functions.
* Hands\-on experience creating battlecards, competitive playbooks, win/loss analyses, and supporting sales in live calls.
* Strong technical aptitude enabling credible engagement with engineering teams, data scientists, and technical prospects during competitive evaluations.
* Proven ability to turn raw data, competitor signals, and field intel into actionable sales plays, positioning shifts, and product guidance.
* Strong analytical skills: comfortable gathering data from varied sources, synthesizing it into crisp, compelling insights.
* Proven ability to turn competitive insights into actionable recommendations for product and GTM teams, with a focus on measurable impact through sales effectiveness and win/loss outcomes.
* Excellent communicator, both verbally and in writing—able to present complex competitive landscapes effectively to diverse internal and external audiences.
* Self\-starter: highly collaborative across functions (sales, marketing, product, CS), with an ability to manage CI initiatives end\-to\-end.
* Familiarity with CI tools (e.g. Klue, Crayon) and market intelligence platforms.

The Health Economics Data Analyst works cross‑functionally with Finance, Revenue Management, and Member Services to deliver reliable data insights that support business operations, financial reporting, and decision‑making. The position requires strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage complex data from multiple systems in a regulated healthcare environment.

Work You'll Do  

  

As a Project Lead Integration Engineer II on the project, you will provide program support and process improvement, support strategic readiness initiatives, program oversight, and assist in the development, tracking, and reporting of force management activities.  

  

* Program Management \& Tracking: Maintain and update program trackers for all MARFORPAC Reserve activations (including status of related administrative and planning requirements). new_jobs.description:
Arcfield Overview: Arcfield was purpose\-built to relentlessly protect the nation and its allies from today’s national security threats. We have nearly 70 years of proven expertise and excel in space superiority, hypersonic defense and nuclear deterrence, digital transformation, and surface and undersea warfare domains. Our solution areas include space mission engineering, atmospheric science, digital engineering, mission assurance, and advances in modeling and simulation that together with our enterprise\-wide adoption of artificial intelligence and machine learning, lead to better systems and timely, reliable decision\-making. Headquartered in Chantilly, VA with 18 North American offices, Arcfield employs 2,200 engineers, scientists, analysts, IT specialists and other professionals who challenge the status quo to deliver an efficient technological advantage to our national security and defense partners. Responsibilities:

Be part of a fast\-paced, high energy, team supporting Navy Strategic Systems Programs Re\-Entry Systems Branch as the Operational Systems Group’ Assistant Program Manager and Fleet Operations Lead Integration Engineer. This unique and challenging role requires a strong understanding of both DOE nuclear weapon systems and DoD delivery platforms. The successful candidate will serve as a key technical liaison, managing a small group of seasoned technical experts, dealing with complex interfaces, ensuring system compatibility in all operational environments/locations, and driving successful integration activities throughout the program lifecycle. The candidate should be intimately familiar with nuclear weapon programs, submarine fleet operations, fleet CONOPS and be able to manage having multiple critical tasks at once. This position will require the candidate to represent the Re\-Entry Systems Branch at various meetings and have a comprehensive understanding of how to lead and manage a project from start to finish.

* Serve as the primary right hand to the Operational Systems Group Program Manager providing high level operational support and ensuring seamless execution.

* Act as a customer liaison representing the Re\-Entry Branch at various meetings.

* Other duties as assigned.

Education can be substituted for military service and subject matter expert knowledge on nuclear programs and/or submarine weapons systems.
* Must possess and maintain active Top Secret clearance.

* Demonstrated ability to lead cross\-functional teams and chair formal working groups with external stakeholders.
* Exceptional ability to translate complex technical data into actionable executive briefings.
* A passion for learning, helping others, sharing team knowledge, and contributing value to the mission in any way possible.

* Strong background in Systems Integration, including resolving hardware/software interface issues in a "System of Systems" environment.
* Willingness to learn and become a subject matter expert.

new_jobs.title: Program Manager, Strategy & Operations (Remote)
new_jobs.description:
We are seeking a **Program Manager, Strategy \& Operations** to join the Office of the President. In this role, you will serve as the quarterback for our Annual Operating Plan (AOP) and Objectives and Key Results (OKRs), driving the disciplined execution and operational excellence required to meet Aledade’s strategic priorities.
  

As a strategic operator and internal consultant, you will partner with leaders across the organization to turn high\-level vision into actionable outcomes. You will be instrumental in bridging the gap between strategy and execution—fostering cross\-functional collaboration, proactively addressing roadblocks, and ensuring our teams remain aligned with our most ambitious goals.
  

This is a unique opportunity to gain direct exposure to senior leadership while developing your operational toolkit. By ensuring our business objectives are translated into successful results, you will contribute directly to Aledade’s mission of empowering independent primary care.

We are flexible with respect to geographic location, and the ideal candidate will be comfortable working remotely/work from home within the US or be based from Bethesda, MD office.

**Primary Duties:**
-------------------



### **Performance Management:**

* **Drive Accountability:** Own the end\-to\-end performance management of AOP Objectives and Key Results, ensuring owners are empowered and accountable for delivering on their targets.
* **Maintain Operational Tempo:** Act as the heartbeat of the AOP, ensuring consistent progress through proactive follow\-ups, closing feedback loops, and keeping cross\-functional workstreams on schedule.
* **Surface \& Mitigate Risk:** Early\-identify systemic risks or operational blockers to OKR success; partner with teams to develop mitigation strategies and escalate critical issues to leadership to ensure a path forward.

### **Strategic \& Annual Planning:**

* **Lead Planning Cycles:** Facilitate the departmental annual planning process and mid\-year (2H) adjustments, ensuring departmental goals remain ambitious yet realistic.
* **Continue to Build the Playbook:** Continuously refine and document the AOP Playbook at Aledade, codifying best practices to make each planning cycle more efficient and predictable than the last.
* **QBR Preparation:** Partner with department Ops Leads to prepare high\-quality materials and narratives for Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), ensuring a data\-driven story of progress and challenges.

### **Cross\-Functional Orchestration \& Alignment:**

* **Stakeholder Management:** Build deep, trust\-based relationships across the organization to facilitate honest discussions regarding progress, resource gaps, and cross\-departmental dependencies.
* **Early Alignment Integration:** Act as the "glue" between departments, ensuring that initiatives have early and consistent alignment with Analytics, Field, and Product stakeholders.
* **Cross\-Functional Bridge:** Serve as the central point of contact to ensure that changes in one department’s roadmap are communicated and reconciled with the broader AOP.

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 5\+ years progressive experience in operations, strategy, program management or consulting
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience

### **Preferred knowledge, skills, and/or abilities:**

* Master’s degree preferred
* Proven ability to build strong relationships, influence without authority, and effectively collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including senior leaders.
* Demonstrated experience in managing projects, tracking performance, and driving execution in a complex environment.  

Ability to think critically, identify issues, and develop actionable strategic solutions.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate complex information to diverse audiences and influence stakeholders.
* Self\-motivated, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability for outcomes.

### **Physical Requirements:**


* Sitting for prolonged periods of time. Extensive use of computers and keyboard. Occasional walking and lifting may be required.
**Who We Are:**
Aledade PBC, a public benefit corporation, exists to empower the most transformational part of our health care landscape \- independent primary care. We were founded in 2014, and since then, we've become the largest network of independent primary care in the country \- helping practices, health centers and clinics deliver better care to their patients and thrive in value\-based care. Additionally, by creating value\-based contracts across a wide variety of health plans, we aim to flip the script on the traditional fee\-for\-service model. Our work strengthens continuity of care, aligns incentives and ensures primary care physicians are paid for what they do best \- keeping patients healthy. If you want to help create a health care system that is good for patients, good for practices and good for society \- and if you're eager to join a collaborative, inclusive and remote\-first culture \- you've come to the right place.

**What Does This Mean for You?**
At Aledade PBC, you will be part of a creative culture that is driven by a passion for tackling complex issues with respect, open\-mindedness and a desire to learn. You will collaborate with team members who bring a wide range of experiences, interests, backgrounds, beliefs and achievements to their work \- and who are all united by a shared passion for public health and a commitment to the Aledade mission.

In addition to time off to support work\-life balance and enjoyment, we offer the following comprehensive benefits package designed for the overall well\-being of our team members:

Flexible work schedules and the ability to work remotely are available for many roles
Health, dental and vision insurance paid up to 80% for employees, dependents and domestic partners
Robust time\-off plan (21 days of PTO in your first year)

We are currently looking for a **Program Manager** for a 100% remote position supporting a large federal government healthcare modernization project. This position will lead the Program Management Office supporting the U.S. Census Bureau's Census Talent Acquisition and Management contract, overseeing cost, schedule, performance, staffing, risk, quality, and contractual compliance. This position is contingent upon contract award.


The Program Manager will lead a geographically dispersed, cross\-functional team operating within a multi\-project, multi\-vendor federal environment. The selected candidate must be available to travel to the Washington, DC metropolitan area as needed to support onsite meetings, program activities, and customer requirements.


The candidate must reside within the continental US.


**Responsibilities**


* Lead the Program Management Office and oversee the cost, schedule, technical performance, staffing, quality, and contractual performance of multiple projects and programs.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for the Contracting Officer, Contracting Officer's Representative, Government Program Manager, Government personnel, subcontractors, and teaming partners.
* Manage the Integrated Program Schedule, program milestones, resource allocations, staffing plans, budgets, forecasts, risks, deliverables, and performance metrics.
* Lead program reviews and provide timely, transparent reporting on financial performance, technical progress, risks, issues, corrective actions, and contract status.
* Ensure cross\-functional integration among technical, operational, administrative, Government, subcontractor, and contractor teams while rapidly coordinating responses to urgent program issues.
* Ensure compliance with contractual, regulatory, administrative, quality, onboarding, training, and reporting requirements across the program.
* Take on additional tasks and responsibilities as needed to support team objectives and ensure the success of the project.

**Requirements**


* Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent experience, with at least 15 years of program or project management experience supporting contracts of comparable size and complexity.
* At least 10 years of experience scoping, designing, executing, monitoring, and evaluating enterprise IT development programs or comparable PMO initiatives.
* Demonstrated experience managing multi\-task contracts, subcontracts, diverse contract types, and multi\-vendor federal delivery environments.
* Project Management Professional certification with expertise in requirements analysis, resource allocation, project costing, deliverable tracking, risk management, schedule management, and financial reporting.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, decision\-making, and problem\-solving abilities, including the ability to respond effectively to complex cost, schedule, staffing, and technical challenges.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, customer engagement, team leadership, and collaboration skills, including experience managing geographically dispersed teams.

**Additional Qualifications**


* Experience supporting U.S. Census Bureau IT systems, decennial census operations, or census data management and modernization initiatives.
* Experience leading programs operating within Agile, DevSecOps, and cloud\-native development environments.
* Experience managing large federal IT programs involving enterprise data platforms, analytics, cybersecurity, and mission\-critical system modernization.

**Security Clearance Requirements**


* U.S. Citizenship is required.
* All selected candidates must complete a background check.
* Ability to obtain and maintain a Government/Public Trust clearance, including required fingerprinting, when required for the position.

**Benefits**


* Medical/Dental/Vision
* 401k with Employer Match
* PTO \+ Federal Holidays
* Corporate Laptop
* Training Opportunities
* Remote Opportunity


**Compensation:** The salary for this position is $165,000, plus individuals may be eligible for an annual discretionary bonus of up to 5%.

Our Benefits

Medical, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance
  
Health Savings Account
  
401(k) with company match
  
Paid time off
  
Tuition Assistance

Summary
  
Balfour Beatty Construction, LLC (Company), a member of the Balfour Beatty plc group of companies, is searching for a CMMC Program Manager to support its compliance with cyber and physical security requirements for Federal Contract Information (FCI) and Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) associated with the Company’s Federal construction contracts, as well as equivalent requirements in private contracts. Candidates must have a strong working knowledge of FAR and DFARS requirements for the handling of FCI and CUI, excellent analytical, project management, communication, and organizational skills.
  
The selected candidate will ideally work out of our Falls Church, VA, office, but candidates based in Dallas, TX, will be considered as well. This is a hybrid position that requires working in the office three days per week and working from home two days per week.
  
The CMMC Program Manager is responsible for managing, maintaining, and continuously improving the organization's Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC) compliance program for the secure enclave supporting Department of Defense (DoD) and other Federal agency CUI, as well as the Company’s policies and procedures for handling FCI. The CMMC Program Manager will serve as the primary liaison between compliance \& ethics, IT, legal, and operations as it relates to governance, reporting, monitoring, assessment and organizational adoption of security requirements necessary to maintain ongoing compliance with NIST SP 800\-171, NIST SP 800\-137, FAR and DFARS requirements, and CMMC Level 1 and Level 2\.
  
  

Essential Functions
  
* Serve as the organization's primary internal authority for CMMC compliance within the secure enclave, providing guidance to IT, IT Security, Operations, Human Resources, Legal, Procurement, Communications and executive leadership regarding FCI, CUI and equivalent compliance obligations and governance requirements.
* Own the organization's CMMC compliance program for the secure enclave, ensuring governance activities remain aligned with organizational objectives, contractual obligations, regulatory requirements, and evolving cybersecurity risks.
* Develop, maintain, and periodically review the Continuous Monitoring Plan (CMP) and support ISCM procedures.
* Develop, review, maintain, and coordinate approval of CMMC\-related policies, standards, procedures, and supporting documentation.
* Define and manage ISCM strategy, risk tolerance, and reporting cadence in coordination with the CIO, CISO, CLO, and US Compliance Team.
* Lead initial implementation, as well as ongoing assessment of security control effectiveness, including vulnerability identification and reporting, configuration compliance, access reviews, and incident monitoring.
* Lead annual CMMC self\-assessments, risk assessments, internal audits, certification readiness activities, and coordination with Certified Third\-Party Assessment Organizations (C3PAOs) for external CMMC assessments, as applicable.
* Present compliance status, risk posture, and strategic recommendations to executive leadership and governance committees.

new_jobs.title: Technical Project Manager, Site Deployment - Mechanical Design Assurance, NA
new_jobs.description:
**About Vantage Data Centers**
==============================

  

Vantage Data Centers powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well\-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands.

**Reliability Engineering**  

The Reliability Engineering Department is responsible for ensuring the operational health of critical systems and the implementation of Site Operations best practices. This includes evaluating the performance and reliability of critical infrastructure, maintaining operational availability through maintenance programs, and providing technical support to Site Operations teams. The department also collaborates closely with the Design Engineering team to provide feedback for future data center designs.

**Position Overview**

**This role will be based near any of our North America office locations, following our flexible work policy (3 days in\-office and 2 days flexible).**

The Sr. Technical Project Manager, Site Deployment \- Mechanical Design Assurance is responsible for providing operationally focused mechanical review and technical assurance for new data center builds, expansions, and major fit\-out projects across the North America portfolio. This role represents Site Operations and Site Deployment during design development, page\-turn reviews, submittal reviews, RFI responses, commissioning strategy alignment, and movement of design packages toward Issued for Construction drawings.  

The position ensures that mechanical systems are designed and delivered in a manner that is operable, maintainable, safe, reliable, and aligned with long\-term Mission Critical Operations requirements. Working closely with Design Engineering, Construction, Commissioning, Business Operations, and local Site Operations teams, this role brings operator perspective into design decisions before construction execution, procurement, and turnover activities create downstream operational risk.

 **Essential Job Functions**

* Serve as the primary Site Deployment representative for mechanical design assurance across assigned campuses, projects, and expansions.
* Participate in design page\-turn reviews and provide operator\-focused comments from concept design through IFC drawing issuance.
* Review mechanical design packages, narratives, specifications, sequences of operation, equipment schedules, and drawing sets for operability, maintainability, accessibility, and reliability.
* Review mechanical submittals, equipment selections, vendor documentation, and proposed alternates to evaluate operational impact, maintenance requirements, and lifecycle risk.
* Support responses to RFIs related to mechanical systems, equipment access, operating modes, redundancy, controls interfaces, maintenance clearances, and long\-term serviceability.
* Evaluate value engineering proposals and design changes to ensure critical operational requirements are not removed, reduced, or compromised without appropriate risk visibility.
* Provide technical input for mechanical commissioning strategies, operational acceptance criteria, testing scripts, TAB requirements, integrated systems testing, and turnover readiness expectations.
* Collaborate with Site Deployment TPMs and future MCO teams to ensure mechanical design intent is carried forward into construction, commissioning, training, CMMS population, and steady\-state operations.
* Capture lessons learned from active operating sites and deployment projects and feed them back into future mechanical design standards, templates, and review criteria.

**Duties and Responsibilities**

* Review mechanical design milestones including 30%, 60%, 90%, IFC, bulletin, and construction revision packages.
* Assess chilled water plants, CRAH/CRAC systems, pumps, piping, valves, heat exchangers, cooling towers, dry coolers, economization systems, filtration, water treatment, controls, and associated support infrastructure.
* Validate maintenance access, equipment clearances, rigging paths, valve accessibility, isolation strategy, redundancy philosophy, and operational workflows within mechanical spaces.
* Track design review comments, assigned actions, and open mechanical issues through closure with Design Engineering, Construction, Commissioning, and Site Operations stakeholders.
* Participate in recurring design coordination meetings, page turns, constructability reviews, operability reviews, and commissioning planning sessions.
* Review MEP coordination impacts where mechanical systems interface with electrical, controls, fire protection, architectural, structural, and civil scopes.
* Provide operator perspective on sequence of operations, controls strategy, sensor placement, alarm strategy, setpoints, trending capability, and emergency operating scenarios.
* Review proposed equipment substitutions or manufacturer deviations for potential impacts to maintainability, spare parts, training, warranty, resilience, and operational standardization.
* Support development of operational design standards, mechanical review checklists, lessons learned repositories, and acceptance criteria used by the Site Deployment organization.
* Partner with local MCO leadership to ensure future operators understand mechanical design intent, operating limitations, maintenance requirements, and known risk items prior to turnover.

**Job Requirements**

* 5\+ years of experience in data center operations, mechanical engineering, commissioning, critical facilities maintenance, construction QA/QC, or mission\-critical infrastructure delivery.
* Strong working knowledge of data center mechanical systems, including chilled water, airside cooling, pumping systems, mechanical controls, water treatment, and supporti

Headquartered in Washington, DC, Versar Global Solutions provides full mission lifecycle solutions for challenges faced by our government and commercial Customers in the natural, built, and digital environments. Requisition ID \# 174164
  
  

**Job Category:** Business Operations / Strategy
  
**Job Level:** Individual Contributor
  
**Business Unit:** People
  
**Work Type:** Hybrid
  
**Job Location:** Oakland
  
  

Department Summary
  
  

The Enterprise Engagement and Culture team helps create the conditions for coworkers to thrive and for teams to perform at their best. We connect coworker insights, culture, inclusion and belonging, and performance practices to strengthen the everyday coworker experience and help the organization deliver on its Purpose, Virtues, and Stands.
  
  

The team leads enterprise strategies and programs that shape and strengthen culture, including Joy at Work, Breakthrough, and Inclusion \& Belonging. We use coworker listening, data, and insights to understand the experiences and mindsets influencing culture, identify opportunities for improvement, and help translate those insights into focused action.
  
  

Through enterprise programs, tools, and partnerships, the team helps leaders and teams strengthen connection, belonging, ownership, and performance; embed desired ways of working into the everyday coworker experience, and build the capabilities needed to turn culture into a driver of business outcomes.
  
  

Position Summary
  
  

As an Expert Data Analyst, you will play a critical role in advancing how the organization uses workforce and culture data to understand the coworker experience and drive measurable improvement. You will transform complex data into actionable enterprise insights by identifying trends, patterns, relationships, and emerging opportunities that extend beyond traditional reporting.
  
  

In this role, you will partner with leaders and cross\-functional teams to translate findings into clear recommendations, identify where targeted interventions and resources can have the greatest impact, and establish meaningful ways to measure progress over time. Through advanced analytics, visualization, and storytelling, you will help leaders move from understanding what the data says to understanding why it matters, where to focus, and what actions are most likely to improve outcomes.
  
  

The role is hybrid working from your remote office and in\-person at Oakland General Office, 2\-3x per month based on business needs.
  
  

Job Responsibilities
  
Performs analysis on highly complex data models that have cross\- functional impact. Applies advanced knowledge to a wide range of business issues. Develop innovative data solutions to address complex business issues. Presents findings and proposed recommendations to leaders. Develop business cases in support of strategy or change initiatives. Works with and leverages relationships with Directors and Managers across functions / PG\&E. Manages cross\-functional projects or initiatives. May provide direction and coaching to other Business Analysts.
  
  

Qualifications
  
  

**Minimum:**  

Bachelor’s degree in business administration or job\-related field or equivalent experience 6 years of related work experience Demonstrated ability to create Lean visual management
  
  

**Desired:**  

Extensive knowledge of different analytical methods, approaches, and tactics Broad expertise in what\-if modeling analysis, concepts, methods and techniques and analysis of how different factors affect business outcomes Creative problem\-solving skills to develop solutions Strong analytical and writing skills to create compelling business cases based on complex business environments and inputs Influence skills to effectively gain buy in from leaders inside and outside of the department Knowledge and understanding of key drivers affecting business results Project management skills to lead large and complex projects working with cross\-functional teams Organizational, prioritization and multitasking skills Adaptable to changing business conditions and ambiguity Advanced skills in Microsoft Office, Project, Visio, or similar software
  
  

Compensation
  
  

PG\&E is providing the full salary/pay range for this position. The actual amount paid to an individual will be based on multiple factors, including, but not limited to, internal equity, specific skills, education, licenses or certifications, experience, market value, and geographic location. The range to reasonably expect will be around the minimum and the midpoint of the range. The final decision will be made on a case\-by\-case basis related to the factors above. This job is also eligible to participate in PG\&E’s discretionary incentive compensation programs.

This role will be based in the US a t our San Francisco or San Jose Office.
